source: Insimbi yesicathulo sokushushuluza eqhweni sanamuhla inezinhlangothi ezimbili negobongo eligumbekile maphakathi kwazo. Imiphetho emibili ivumela ukubamba okungcono kweqhwa, ngisho noma ziketukile.
target: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

source: Ngenxa yokuthi ingaphansi locezu lugobile kancane, njengoba ucezu lutshekela ohlangothini olulodwa noma kolunye, unqanqama oluthintene neqhwa nalo luyatsheka.
target: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

source: Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abashushuluzi baphenduke. Uma izishushuluziziphenukela ngakwesokudla, umshushuluzi uphendukela ngakwesokudla, uma izishushuluzi ziphendukela ngakwesobunxele, umshushuluzi uphenukela ngakwesobunxele.
target: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

source: Ukuze zibuyele emazingeni wazo wangaphambili wamandla, kumelwe ziqede amandla engeziwe eziwathole ekukhanyeni.
target: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

source: Zenza lokhu ngokukhipha inhlayiyana yokukhanya ebizwa "nge-photon".
target: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

source: Ososayenzi babiza lenqubo ngokuthi “ukukhishwa kwemisebe okushukumisiwe” ngoba ama-athomu ashukunyiswa ukukhanya okukhanyayo, okubangela ukukhishwa kokukhanya kwefothoni, futhi ukukhanya uhlobo lwemisebe.
target: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

source: Isithombe esilandelayo sibonisa ama-athomu akhipha ama-photon. Eqinisweni ama-photon mancane kakhulu kunalawa asesithombeni.
target: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

source: Ama-phothon mancane kakhulu kunezinto ezenza ama-athomu!
target: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

source: Ngemuva kokusebenza amahora amakhulu umucu wasibani ugcina ushile bese isibani singasasebenzi.
target: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

source: Isibani sesidinga ukushintshwa. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela mawushintsha isibani sokukhanya.
target: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

source: Okokuqala, isiqhebeza sesibani kumelwe sicinywe noma ikhebula ingaxhunywa.
target: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

source: Lokhu kungenxa yokuba ugesi ungena kuyisokhethi lapho ingxenye yenzimbi yebhalubhu ingakubamba kabuhlungu ngogesi uma uthinta ingaphakathi lesokhethi noma ingaphansi lensimbi lapho isengaphakathi kwesokhethi ngokwengxenye.
target: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

source: Isitho esikhulu esimisweni sokujikeleza kwegazi inhliziyo, empompa igazi.
target: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

source: Igazi liphuma enhliziyweni ngamapayipi abizwa ngeminqonqo futhi lingene enhliziyweni ngamapayipi abizwa ngemithambo. Amapayipi amancane kunawo wonke abizwa ngemithanjana.
target: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

source: Izinyo le-triceratops lalingakwazi ukuhlafuna hhayi kuphela amacembe kodwa namagatsha aqine kakhulu kanye nezimpande.
target: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

source: Abanye ososayensi bacabanga ukuthi ama-Ticeratop ayedla ama-cycad, okuwuhlobo lwezitshalo olwaluvamile e-Cretaceous.
target: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

source: Lezi zitshalo sibukeka njengesihlala sesundu namaqabunga acijile, ahlabayo.
target: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

source: ITriceratops yayingasebenzisa umlomo wayo oqinile ukuhluba amaqabunga ngaphambi kokudla isiqu.
target: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

source: Abanye ososayensi bathi lezi zitshalo zinobuthi ngakho akunakwenzeka ukuthi ikhona i-dinosaur ezidlile, ngisho noma namuhla ibheja kanye nezinye izilwane ezinjengopholi (inzalo yama-dinosaur) zingadla amagatsha noma izithelo ezinobuthi.
target: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

source: Amandla wokudonsa we-Io angasebenza kanjani kimi? Uma uma emhlabeni we-lo, uzoba nesisindo esincane kunaleso oba naso Emhlabeni.
target: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

source: Umuntu onesisindo esingamaphawundi angu-200 (90kg) eMhlabeni angaba nesisindo esicishe sibe amaphawundi angu-36 (16kg) e-Io. Ngakho amandla okudonsa, empeleni, akudonsa kancane.
target: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

source: ILanga alinawo ungqimba njengoMhlaba lelo ongema kulo. ILanga lonke lenziwe ngamagesi, umlilo, kanye ne-plasma.
target: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

source: Igesi iba yincane njengoba uhamba uqhela enkabeni yeLanga.
target: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

source: Ingxenye engaphandle esiyibonayo lapho sibuka iLanga ibizwa ngokuthi yi-photosphere, okusho ukuthi “indilinga yokukhanya”.
target: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

source: Cishe eminyakeni eyizinkulungwane ezintathu kamuva, ngo-1610, isazi sezinkanyezi somNtaliyane uGalileo Galilei wasebenzisa i-telescope ukubuka ukuthi iVenus inezigaba, njengoba nenyanga inazo.
target: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

source: Izigaba zenzeka kuphela ngoba uhlangothi lweVenus (noma iNyanga) olubhekene nelanga luyakhanya. Izigaba zeVenus zisekela inkolelo-mbono kaCopenicus yokuthi amapulanethi azungeza ilanga.
target: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

source: Kwathi, emva kweminyaka embalwa ngo-1639. Isazi sezinkanyezi somNgisi esibizwa ngo-Jeremiya Horrocks sabheka umzila we-Venus.
target: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

source: INgilandi yayibe nenkathi ende yokuthula ngemva kokunqoba kabusha iDanelaw.
target: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

source: Nokho ngo-991 i-Ethelred yayibhekene nemikhumbi yamabutho wamaViking emikhulu kunanoma imiphi kusukela kweyeGuthrum ikhulu leminyaka ngaphambili.
target: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

source: Le mikhumbi eminingi beyiholwa u-Olaf Trygvasson, umuntu waseNorway owayenentshisekelo yokukhulula izwe lakhe ekuphathweni yi-Denmark.
target: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

source: Ngemva kwezinkinga zempi zasekuqaleni, u-Ethelred wakwazi ukuvumelana no-Olaf, owabuyela e-Norway eyozama ukuthola umbuso wakhe ngempumelelo exubene.
target: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

source: I-Hangeul ukuphela kohlamvu olusungulwe ngenhloso ekusebenziseni kwansuku zonke okuthandwayo. Lolu hlamvu lwasungulwa ngo-1444 ngesikhathi sokubusa kweNkosi uSejong (1418 – 1450).
target: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

source: INkosi u-Sejong wayeyinkosi yesine yoBukhosi buka-Joseon futhi ungomunye wabathathelwa phezulu kakhulu.
target: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

source: Ekuqaleni unike igama i-alfabhethi yeHangeul ngokuthi iHunmin Jeongeum, okusho ukuthi "imisindo efanele yokufundisa abantu".
target: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

source: Kunezinkolelo-mbono eziningi zendlela iSanskrit ebekhona ngayo. Enye yazo imayelana nokuthutha kwama-Aryan esuka entshonalanga aya eNdiya abaze nolimi lwabo.
target: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

source: ISanskrit ulimi lwamandulo futhi lungaqhathaniswa nolimi lwesiLatin olukhulunywa eYurophu.
target: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

source: Incwadi yakuqala kunazo zonke emhlabeni eyaziwayo yayibhalwe ngeSanskrit. Ngemva kokubhalwa kwama-Upanishad, iSanskrit yamane yanyamalala ngenxa yezigaba zokubaluleka.
target: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

source: I-Sanskrit iwulimi oluyinkimbinkimbi nolucebile, luye lwaba oluyinhloko ezilimini eziningi zanamuhla zaseNdiya, njengesi-Lathini luwulimi oluyinhloko ezilimini zaseYurophu njengesiFulentshi kanye nesiPanishi.
target: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

source: Ngokuphela kwempi ye-France , i-Germany yaqala ukuzilungiselela ukuhlasela isiqhingi sase-Britain.
target: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

source: IJalimane libize ukuhlasela ngegama eliyisifekethiso elithi "Operation Sealion". Iningi lezikhali ezisindayo zeButho laseBrithani kanye nempahla zilahlekile lapho lithutha eDunkirk, ngakho ibutho lalibuthakathaka kakhudlwana.
target: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

source: Kodwa iRoyal Navy yayisanamandla kuneGerman Navy ("Kriegsmarine") futhi yayingabhubhisa noma imiphi imikhumbi ehlaselayo phesheya kwe-English Channel.
target: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

source: Nokho, iMikhumbi Yempi yaseBukhosini embalwa kakhulu eyayiseduze nemizila yokuhlasela njengoba izindunankulu zemikhubi yempi zazesaba ukuthi zizocwiliswa ukuhlasela kwamaJalimane okuvela emoyeni.
target: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

source: Ake siqale ngencazelo emayelana nezinhlelo zeNtaliyane. INtaliyane ngokuyinhloko “bekuwumfowabo omncane” weJalimane neJapani.
target: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

source: Banamabutho angenamandla kanye nemikhumbi yempi engenamandla, ngisho noma bakhe imikhumbi emisha emine ngaphambi nje kokuqala kwempi
target: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

source: Izinhloso eziphambili zase-Italy kwakungamazwe ase-Afrika. Ukuze bathumbe lawo mazwe, babezodinga indawo yokuthumela amasosha, ukuze kuthi njengoba amasosha ewela uLwandle iMedithera ngemikhumbi ahlasele i-Afrika.
target: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

source: Ngalesosizathu, bekufanele ukuthi banyamalalise izintu zempi zaseBrithani kanye nemikhumpi eGibhithe. Ngaphandle kwalezozinyathelo, imikhumbi yempi yaseNtaliyane bekungafanele yenze okunye okuthile .
target: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

source: Manje eJapani. IJapani bekuyisiqhingi esiyizwe, njengeBhrithani.
target: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

source: Imikhumbi yangaphansi kwamanzi imikhumbi eklanyelwe ukuhamba ngaphansi kwamanzi, futhi ihlale lapho isikhathi eside kakhulu.
target: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

source: Imikhumbi yangaphansi kwamanzi yayisetshenziswa eMpini Yezwe I kanye naseMpini Yezwe II. Ngaleso sikhathi yayihamba kancane kakhulu futhi beyikwazi ukudubula ibanga elifishane.
target: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

source: Ekuqaleni kwempi yahamba kakhulu ngaphezu kolwandle, kodwa njengoba ireda yaqala ukukhula nokucacisa okwengeziwe, imikhumbi yangaphansi komhlaba yaphoqelelwa ukuba ihambe ngaphansi kwamanzi ukuze ingabonwa.
target: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

source: Imikhumbi yangaphansi kwamanzi yaseJalimane yayibizwa ngokuthi Izikebhe ze-U. AmaJalimane ayenekhono lokuqondisa nokusebenzisa imikhumbi yabo yangaphansi kwamanzi.
target: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

source: Ngenxa yokuphumelela kwawo emikhumbini yangaphansi kwamanzi, ngemva kwempi akuthenjwa ukuthi amaJalimane anayo eminingi.
target: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

source: Yebo! INkosi uTutankhamun, kwesinye isikhathi ebizwa "ngeNkosi uTut" noma "INkosi enguMfana", ingenye yamakhosi aziwa kakhulu waseGibhithe yamandulo ezikhathini zanamuhla.
target: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

source: Ngokuthakazelisayo, wayengathathwa njengobaluleke kakhulu ezikhathini zamandulo futhi wayengabhaliwe ezinhlwini eziningi zamakhosi zakudala.
target: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

source: Nokho, ukutholwa kwethuna lakhe ngo-1922 kwamenza usowaziwayo. Nakuba amathuna amaningi wangezikhathi ezidlule egcekeziwe, leli thuna lalishiywe cishe lingaphazanyiswanga.
target: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

source: Izinto eziningi ezingcwatshwe noTutankhamun zilondolozwwe kahle, kuhlanganise nezinkulungwane zezimpahla ezenziwe ngezinsimbi eziyigugu kanye namatshe anqabile.
target: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

source: Ukusungulwa kwamasondo kwenza izinqola zase-Asiriya ukuba zingasindi kakhulu, zisheshe, futhi zikulungele kangcono ukushiya amasosha nezinye izinqola.
target: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

source: Imicibisholo evela eminsalweni yayo ebulalayo yayingabhoboza izembatho zempi zamasosha ezimbangi. Cishe ngo-1000 B.C., abase-Asiriya basebenzisa amasosha agibeleyo okuqala.
target: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

source: Amasosha agibeleyo ibutho elilwa ligibele amahhashi. Izihlalo zamahhashi bezingakasungulwa, ngakho ibutho lamahhashi lama-Asiriya belilwa ngaphezu kwamahhashi angenazihlalo.
target: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

source: Siyabazi abezombangazwe abaningi bamaGriki, ososayensi, kanye namaciko. Kungenzeka ukuthi umuntu owaziwa kakhulu waleli siko u-Homer, imbongi eyimpumputhe edumile, obhale izincwadi ezimbili zesiGriki zobungcweti: izinkondo ze-Iliad kanye ne-Odyssey.
target: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

source: USophocles kanye no-Aristophanes basasengababhali bemidlalo abathandwayo futhi imidlalo yabo ithathwa njengemisebenzi emikhulu kakhulu yezincwadi zezwe.
target: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

source: Omunye umGreki odumile usozibalo uPythagoras, owaziwa kakhulu ngomqondo wakhe oqinisekiswa ngokuchasiselwa odumile omayelana nokuhlangana phakathi kwezinhlangothi zonxantathu abanezinhlangothi ezimbili eziqondene ngqo.
target: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

source: Kunokulinganisela okuhlukile kwenani labantu abakhuluma isiHindi. Kulinganiselwa ukuthi siphakathi kolimi oluvame kakhulu emhlabeni lwesibili kanye nolwesine.
target: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

source: Inani lezikhulumi zendawo liyahluka kuye ngokuthi ulimi lwesigodi oluhlobene kakhulu luyabalwa yini noma cha.
target: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

source: Ukulinganisela kusuka ezigidini ezingu-340 kuya ezigidini ezingu-500 zezikhulumi, futhi abantu abangangezigidi ezingu-800 bayaluqonda ulimi.
target: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

source: IsiHindi nesi-Urdu ziyafana ngohlelo lwamagama kodwa ziyahluka ngokubhala; ekukhulumeni kwansuku zonke, izikhulumi zezilimi zombili ngokuvamile ziyakwazi ukuzwisisana.
target: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

source: Cishe ngekhulu lama-15 leminyaka, inyakatho Estonia beyingaphansi kwethonya elikhulu lesiko laseJalimane.
target: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

source: Ezinye izindela zamaJalimane bezifuna ukusondeza uNkulunkulu ebantwini bomdabu, ngakho zasungula ulimi lokubhala lwase-Estonia.
target: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

source: Belusekelwe kuma-alfabhethi wesiJalimane futhi uhlamvu olulodwa "u-Õ/õ" lwanezelwa.
target: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

source: Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, amagama amaningi ayebolekwe kwelaseJalimane ahlanganiswa. Lokhu kwakuyisiqalo sokukhanya.
target: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

source: Ngokwesiko, indlalifa yobukhosi izoya ngokuqondile emabuthweni empi ngemva kokuqeda isikole.
target: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

source: Noma kunjalo, uChales waya enyuvesi eKolishi LikaZiqu Zintathu, e-Cambridge lapho afundela khona i-Anthropology kanye ne-Archaeology, futhi kamuza eZomlando, ethola u-2:2 (idigiliyi engaphansi yezinga lesibili).
target: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

source: UCharles wayeyilungu lokuqala loMkhaya wamaNgisi waseBukhosini lokunikwa idigiliyi.
target: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

source: ITheki yaseYurophu (i-Thrace esempumalanga noma i-Rumelia esenhlonhlweni ye-Balkan) ihlanganisa u-3% wezwe.
target: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

source: Indawo yaseTheki ingaphezu kwamakhilomitha angu-1,600 (1,000 mi) ubude kanye no-800 km (500 mi) ububanzi, nesibumbeko esicishe sibe ama-angela ayisikwele onke.
target: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

source: Indawo yaseTheki, kuhlanganise namachibi, ingamakhilomitha skwele angu-783,562 (300,948 sq mi), lapho amakhilomitha skwele angu-755,688 (291,773 sq mi) ase-Asia eseningizimu ntshonalanga futhi amakhilomitha skwele angu-23,764 (9,174 sq mi) aseYurophu.
target: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

source: Indawo yaseTheki iyenza izwe elikhulu kakhulu lama-37 emhlabeni, futhi ingalingana neDolobha Elikhulu laseFulansi noMbuso Ohlangene kuhlangene.
target: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

source: ITheki izungezwe izilwandle ezinhlangothini ezintathu: uLwandle i-Aegean ngasentshonalanga, uLwandle Olumnyama ngasenyakatho kanye noLwandle iMedithera ngaseningizimu.
target: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

source: I-Luxembourg inomlando omude wokuzimela kusukela ngo-1839.
target: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

source: Izingxenye zeBheljiyamu yanamuhla beziyingxenye ye-Luxembourg esikhathini esidlule kodwa zaba yingxenye yeBheljiyamu ngemva koShintsho lwaseBheljiyamu lwangawo-1830.
target: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

source: ILuxembourg ibihlale iyizwe elizama ukungathathi uhlangothi kodwa beyihilelekile kokubili eMpini Yezwe I kanye neMpi Yezwe II neJalimane.
target: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

source: Ngo-1957 i-Luxembourg yaba yilungu elisungulayo lenhlangano namuhla eyaziwa ngokuthi iNyunyoni yaseYurophu.
target: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

source: I-Drukgyal Dzong inqaba enkulu echithakele nemonasteli yamaBhuda engxenyeni engenhla yeSigodi saseParo (eMzaneni wasePhondey)
target: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

source: Kuthiwa ngo-1649, uZhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel wenza inqaba ukuze akhumbule ukunqoba kwakhe amabutho aseTibet yaseMongol.
target: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

source: Ngo-1951, umlilo ubangele ukuba ezinye nje zezinto ezasala zaseDrukgyal Dzong ukuba zisale, njengomfanekiso kaZhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
target: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

source: Ngemva komlilo, inqaba yasindiswa yaphinde yavikelwa, yasala ingenye yezinto ezihehayo ngokuthinta inhliziyo zase-Bhutan.
target: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

source: Phakathi nekhulu lama-18 leminyaka iKhambhodiya yazithola iminyene phakathi komakhelwne ababili abanamandla, i-Thailand kanye neVietnam.
target: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

source: AbaseThailand bahlasele i-Cambodia izikhathi eziningana ngekhulu lama-18 leminyaka kanti ngo-1772 babhubhisa i-Phnom Phen.
target: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

source: Eminyakeni yokugcina yekhulu lama-18 leminyaka abantu baseVietnam babuye bahlasela iKhambodiya.
target: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

source: Amaphesenti ayishumi nesishiyagalombili abantu baseVenezuela awasebenzi, futhi iningi lalabo abasebenzayo libambe amatoho.
target: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

source: Ingxenye yesithathu kwezimbili yabantu baseVenezuela abasebenzayo basebenza emkhakheni wokukhonza, cishe ingxenye yesine isebenza ezimbonini futhi ingxenye yesithathu isebenza kwezokulima.
target: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

source: Imboni ebalulekile yabantu baseVenezuela u-oyela, lapho izwe lithengisa kakhulu kunokuthenga, nakuba iphesenti ililodwa kuphela lisebenza embonini kawoyela.
target: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

source: Ekuqaleni kokuzimela kwesizwe, ubungoti be-Singapore Botanic Gardens basiza ekuguquleni isiqhingi ukuthi sibe Idolobha leNgadi lasendaweni eshisayo.
target: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

source: Ngo-1981, uVanda wakhumbula uJoaquim, iorchid hybrid, yakhethwa njengendaba yezwe
target: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

source: Minyaka yonke ngabo-Okthoba izilwane ezidla imifino ezicishe zibe yizigidi ezingu-1,5 ziyahamba zibheke emathafeni aseningizimu, ziwela uMfula i-Mara, zisuka emagqumeni asenyakatho ukuze zitole imvula.
target: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

source: Futhi emuva enyakatho ngasentshonalanga, ukweqa umfula iMara futhi, ngemva kwezimvula cishe zango April.
target: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

source: Indawo yaseSerengeti ineSerengeti National Park, iNgorongoro Conservation Area kanye neMaswa Game Reserve eTanzania kanye neMaasai Mara National Reserve eKenya.
target: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

source: Ukufunda ukwenza ezezindaba ezihilelanayo kudinga amakhono avamile nangokwesikho, kanye namathuluzi afundwe kahle emakilasini ahilelanayo (indaba edwetshwe eshadini, ukuhlela umsindo nevidiyo, ukuxoxa izindaba, njll.)
target: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

source: Imiklamo ehlanganisiwe idinga uphinde uhlole ukucabangela kwakho mayelana nokukhishwa kwezindaba futhi ufunde ukucabanga ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene.
target: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

source: Imiklamo yekhompyutha idinga izici zephrojekthi zihlangane ndawonye, kodwa futhi zenze ingqondo uma zizimele.
target: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

source: Isici esilahlekelisayo sezibuko zokukhulisa ukuthi ukuphica kwefokasi kanye nesibalo sezici zezibuko ezidingekayo ukufinyelela ububanzi bobude befokasi bukhulu kakhulu kunezibuko ezisemqoka.
target: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

source: Lokhu kuya ngokuba inkinga elungisekayo njengoba abenza izibuko befinyelela amazinga aphakeme okwenza izibuko.
target: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

source: Lokhu kuvumele ukwakhiwa kwezibuko ezibonisa eduze ukuthi kuphinde kukhiqizwe olunye uhlobo lwezinga eliphezulu uma kuqhathaniswa nalezi ezinye.
target: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

source: Okunye ukungathandeki kwamalensi okukhulisa iznto ukuthi ubukhulu bemboniso engenisa ukukhaya (isivinini) belensi buphansi ngokuvamile.
target: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

source: Lokhu kwenza amalensi angabizi kakhulu ka-zoom angasebenziseki kalula endaweni enokukhanya okuncane ngaphandle kwesibani.
target: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

source: Inkinga evamile lapho uzama ukuguqula ifilimu ibe uhlobo lwe-DVD ukuthi isithombe siba sikhulu ngokweqile.
target: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

source: Amathelevishini amaningi enziwe ngendlela yokuthokozisa umphakathi ovamile.
target: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

source: Ngenxa yalesosizathu, konke okubona kuTV kusikwe imingcele yakho, phezulu, ezansi kanye nasezinhlangothini.
target: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

source: Lokhu kwenzelwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isithombe semboza isikrini sonke. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-overscan.
target: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

source: Ngeshwa, uma wenza iDVD, imingcele yayo cishe izosikeka nayo, futhi uma ividiyo ibinamazwi abhalwayo eduze nasezansi, angeke avezwe ngokugcwele.
target: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

source: Izinqaba zakudala ezingokwesiko zishukumise umcabango isikhathi eside, zenza izithombe zemiqhudelwano yokulwa ngemikhonto phezu kwamahhashi, imicimbi kanye nemithetho yamaqhawe yenkathi ka-Arthur.
target: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

source: Ngisho nokuma phakathi kwamanxiwa ayinkulungwane yeminyaka ubudala kulula ukukhumbula imisindo nephunga lezimpi ezidlule kudala, ukucishe uzwe ukukhenceza kwezinselo ezindaweni ezigandayiwe kanye nokuhogela ukwesaba okuphuma ematilongweni angumgodi.
target: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

source: Kodwa ingabe imicabango yethu isekelwe ngokoqobo? Kungani kwakhiwa izinqaba nje kwasekuqaleni? Zaqanjwa kanjani futhi zakhiwa kanjani?
target: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

source: Ngokuvamile enkathini, iKirby Muxloe Castle iyindlu eqinile kakhulu kunokuba inqaba yangempela.
target: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

source: Amafasitela wayo wengilazi amakhulu nezindonga ezilula bezingeke zikwazi ukumelana nokuhlaselwa kwangempela isikhathi eside.
target: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

source: Ngawo-1480, lapho ukwakhiwa kwayo kuqalwa iNkosi uHastings, izwe belinokuthula kakhudlwana futhi ukuzivikela bekudingeka emaviyweni amancane kuphela wabaphangi.
target: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

source: Ukulinganiselwa kwamandla inqubo amazwe aseYurophu ayefuna ukugcina ubukhosi bezwe ngayo kuzo zonke izifunda zaseYurophu.
target: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

source: Umbono bekuwukuthi zonke izizwe zaseYurophu kwakumelwe zifune ukuvimbela isizwe esisodwa ukuthi sibe namandla, futhi ngenxa yalokho ohulumeni bezwe babeshintsha imifelandawonye yabo kaningi ukuze kube nokulinganisela.
target: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

source: IMpi Yokulandelana Kobukhosi baseSpeyini yaphawula impi yokuqala leyo impikiswano yayo enkulu kwakungukulinganiselwa kwamandla.
target: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

source: Lokhu kube ushintsho olubalulekile, njengoba imibuso yaseYurophi beyingeke isakwazi ukuqasha ngezimpi ezingokwenkolo. Ngakho, iMpi yeMinyaka engaMashumi amaThathu bekuzoba yimpi yokugcina ebizwa ngokuthi yimpi engokwenkolo.
target: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

source: Ithempeli lika-Athemisi e-Efesu labhujiswa ngoJulayi 21, 356, BCE esenzweni sokuthungela ngomlilo esenzwe u-Herostratus.
target: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

source: Ngokwendaba, okwakumshukumisa kwakuwukuthola udumo kumnyama kubomvu. Abase-Efesu, bethukuthele begane unwabu, bamemezela ukuthi igama likaHerostratus lingagcinwa ngokubhalwa.
target: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

source: Isazi-mlando somGreki uStrabo kamuva wabhala igama, okuyindlela esazi ngayo namuhla. Ithempeli labhujiswa ngobusuku obufanayo lobo u-Alexander Omkhulu azalwa ngabo.
target: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

source: U-Alexander, njengenkosi, wacela ukukhokhelela ukwakhiwa kabusha kwethempeli, kodwa isicelo sakhe asivunyelwanga. Kamuva, ngemva kokuba u-Alexander efile, ithempeli lakhiwa kabusha ngo-323 BCE.
target: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

source: Qinisekisa ukuthi isandla sakho sixhekethile ngangokunokwenzeka njengoba usacindezela amanothi afanele – futhi zama ukunganyakazisi iminwe yakho ngokungadingekile.
target: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

source: Ngalendlela, uzozikhathalisa kancane ngangokunokwenzeka. Khumbula ukuthi asikho isidingo sokucindezela izinkinobho ngamandla amakhulu ukuze kube nomsindo owengeziwe njenge-piano.
target: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

source: Ukuze uthole umsindo owengeziwe, ensimbini yomculo ingositini, usebenzisa lokhu okungezansi okunamandla kanye nejubane eliphezulu.
target: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

source: UbuMistiki ukufuna ukuhlanganyela, ukuzibonakalisa, noma ukuzazi kahle nokungokoqobo okuphakeme, ubunkulunkulu, iqiniso elingokomoya, noma uNkulunkulu.
target: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

source: Lo okholelwayo ufuna okwenzekayo okuqondile, noma ukuqonda izinto ezingokoqobo zaphezulu/zikankulunkulu noma onkulunkulu.
target: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

source: Abalandeli balandela indlela ezithile zokuphila, noma imikhuba ehloselwe ukukhulisa lezo zinto ezenzekayo.
target: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

source: Ubumistiki bungahlukaniswa nezinye izinhlobo zezinkolelo ezingokwenkolo nokukhulekela ngokugxila kokwenzekeni kuwe uqobo esimweni sokuba khona esihlukile, ikakhulukazi leso sokuthula, ukuqonda, ukuthokoza, ngisho nokujabula ngokwedlulele.
target: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

source: UbuSikh inkolo yaphakathi ezwekazini laseNdiya. Buqale endaweni yasePunjab phakathi nekhulu lama-15 leminyaka kusuka ekuhlukaneni kwamahlelo phakathi nesiko lobuHindu.
target: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

source: AmaSikh athatha ukholo lwawo njengenkolo ehlukile kubuHindu nakuba evuma umsuka wabo wobuHindu namasiko.
target: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

source: Ama-Sikh abiza inkolo yawo ngokuthi yiGurmat, okusho ukuthi “indlela yomfundisi”. NgesiPunjabi umfundisi isici esisemqoka sazo zonke izinkolo zobuNdiya kodwa enkolweni yobuSikh unokubaluleka okwakha umnyombo wezinkolelo zobuSikh.
target: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

source: Le nkolo yasungulwa ekhulwini leminyaka lama-15 uMfundisi uNanak (1469–1539). Kwalandela abanye abefundisi abayisishiyagalolunye ngokulandelana.
target: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

source: Nokho, NgoJuni 1956, izithembiso zavivinywa lapho iziteleka e-Poland, lapho izisebenzi bezibhikishela ukusweleka kokudla nokuncishiselwa iholo, zishintsha ziba ukubhikisha okuvamile ngokumelene nobuKhomanisi.
target: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

source: Nakuba ekugcineni, uKrushchev ethumele izinqola zempi ukuzodambisa isimo, uye wavumela ezinye izicelo zezomnotho futhi wavuma ukumisa uWladyslaw Gomulka othandwayo njengendunankulu entsha.
target: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

source: Umphakathi wesiGodi sase-Indus kwakuwumphakathi Wenkathi yeBhulonze ezweni laseNdiya elisentshonalanga nyakatho elihlanganisa ubuningi bePakistan yanamuhla kanye nezinye izinkolo entshonalanga nyakatho Ndiya nasempumalanga nyakatho Afghanistan.
target: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

source: Impucuko ichume ezweni elithuthelela amanzi emfuleni laseMfuleni i-Indus lapho ithole igama layo khona.
target: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

source: Nakuba ezinye izazi zicabangela ukuthi njengoba umphakathi ube khona ezigodini zoMfula iSarasvati owomile manje, kufanele ubizwe ngokufanele ngokuthi i-Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, njengoba abanye bewubiza iHarappan Civilization ngemva kweHarappa, eyokuqala yezindawo zayo zokuvubukulwa ngawo-1920,
target: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

source: Isimo sokulwa sombusa waseRoma sisizile ekuthuthukisweni kwentuthuko yezokwelapha.
target: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

source: Odokotela baqala ukubizwa uMbusi u-Augustus futhi waze wenza neButho Lezokwelapha laseRoma lokuqala lokusetshenziswa ngemva kwezimpi.
target: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

source: Odokotela banolwazi lwezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokulalisa okuhlanganisa i-morphine ephuma ezinhlavini ze-poppy kanye ne-scopolamine ephuma ezinhlavini ze-herbane.
target: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

source: Baye baba nekhono ekunqumeni izitho zomzimba ukuze basindise izguli kwi-gangrene nakwi-tourniquet kanye nakuma-arterila clampsukuze kuhambe igazikwehle ukuhamba kwegazi.
target: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

source: Emakhulwini eminyaka amaningana, umbuso waseRoma wathola izinzuzo eziningi emkhakheni wezokwelapha futhi wenza ulwazi oluningi esinalo namuhla.
target: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

source: I-Pureland origami i-origami onokukhawulelwa kokuthi ukusonga okukodwa kuphela kungenziwa ngesikhathi, okunye ukusonga okuyinkimbinkimbi njengokusongela emuva akuvunyelwe, futhi konke ukusonga kunezindawo eziqondile.
target: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

source: Yakhiwe uJohn Smith ngawo-1970 ukusiza abagoqi abangenalwazi noma labo abanamakhono okunyakazisa umzimba alinganiselwe.
target: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

source: Izingane zikwazi ukubona ubuhlanga nezinkolelo ezinganembile zobuhlanga zisencane kakhulu futhi lezi zinkolelo ezinganembile zobuhlanga zithinta indlela eziziphatha ngayo.
target: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

source: Ngokwesibonelo, izingane zohlanga oluncane ezijwayezwe ukuthi azisebenzi kahle esikoleni zivame ukungasebenzi kahle esikoleni lapho zifunda ngomqondo ojwayezwayo ohlotshaniswa nohlanga lwazo.
target: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

source: I-MySpace yiwebusayithi yesithathu ethandwa kakhulu eMelika futhi inamaphrofayela ayizigidi ezingu-54 okwamanje.
target: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

source: Lawa mawebhusayithi atholwe ukunaka okukhulu, ikakhulukazi esimweni semfundo.
target: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

source: Lezi izici ezinhle kulawa mawebhusayithi, ahlanganisa, ukukwazi ukumisa ikhasi lekilasi elingahlanganisa amabhulogi, amavidiyo, izithombe, kanye nezinye izici.
target: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

source: Kungafinyelelwa kalula kuleli khasi ngokunikeza ikheli elilodwa vo lewebhu, okwenza kube lula ukulikhumbula futhi kube lula nokulibhala kubafundi okungenzeka babe nenkinga yokusebenzisa ikhibhodi noma yesipelingi.
target: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

source: Ingahlelwa ngokuqokwa ukuyenza ifundeke kalula futhi ngemibala iminingi noma emincane njengoba umuntu ethanda.
target: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

source: Isifo Sokuthanda Ukunakwa "yisifo se-neurological syndrome esivame ukubonakalangezimpawu ezihlanganisa ukwenza izinto ngokunganaki, ukuphazamiseka, kanye nokuba nomdlandla ngokweqile noma amandla ngokweqile".
target: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

source: Akukhona ukukhubazeka kokufunda, inkinga yokufunda; ithinta "amaphesenti angu-3-5 wazo zonke izingane, cishe izingane zaseMelika ezingaba izigidi ezingu-2".
target: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

source: Izingane ezine-ADD zibhekana nobunzima uma kufanele ukuthi zibhekane nemisebenzi yazo yesikole, kodwa ziyakwazi ukugxila ezintweni ezithanda ukuzenza njengokudlala imidlalo noma ukubukela opopayi noma ukubhala imisho engenazo izimpawo zokubhala.
target: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

source: Lezi zingane zizithola zisobishini ngenxa ”yokuzigaxa ekuziphatheni okuyingozi, ziyalwa, zilwisana nabasegunyeni” ukuze nje zishukumise izingqondo zazo, njengoba izingqondo zazo zingashukunyiswa ngezindlela ezivamile.
target: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

source: I-ADD ithinta ubudlelwane nabanye ontanga ngoba ezinye izingane azikwazi ukuqonda ukuthi ziziphatha ngendlela ezenza ngayo noma ukuthi kungani zipela ngendlela ezenza ngayo noma ukuthi izinga lazo lokukhula lihlukile.
target: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

source: Njengoba ikhono lokuthola ulwazi kanye nelokufunda lishintshe ngendlela echazwe ngenhla izinga eliyisisekelo lelo ulwazi olwalutholwa ngalo lashintshwa.
target: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

source: Indlela yokuthola ukwaziswa yayihlukile. Ukucindezeleka kwakungasahlali enkumbulweni yomuntu, kodwa kwagxilwa ekhonweni lokukhumbula umbhalo kakhudlwana.
target: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

source: Ngempela, iNguquko yenze ushintsho olukhulu endleni yokufunda nasekusabalaliseni ulwazi.
target: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

source: Ngokungafani nezinye izilwane ezicishe zifane nomuntu, izimfene azisazisebenzisi izandla zazo ukuze zihambe noma ukuthwala izinto noma ukushwiba ezihlahleni.
target: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

source: Isandla se-chimpanzee kanye nonyawo ziyafana ngobukhulu kanye nobude, okubonisa ukusetshenziswa kwesandla ekuthwaleni isisindo ekuhambeni ngamaqupha.
target: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

source: Isandla somuntu sifushane kunonyawo, ngama-phalange athe ukuqonda kakhudlwana.
target: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

source: Amathambo esandla okwembiwa eminyakeni eyizigidi ezimbili kuya kwezintathu ubudala aveza lokhu kuguquka kwesandla kokusetshenziswa kwesandla kusuka ekusinyakaziseni kuya ekusisebenziseni.
target: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

source: Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi ukuba namaphupho amaningi lapho uzibona khona ukuthi uyaphupha okuzenzela kungakhathalisa kakhulu kaningi.
target: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

source: Isizathu esiyinhloko salombono umphumela wamaphupho lapho uzibona khona ukuthi uyaphupha anweba ubude besikhathi phakathi kwezimo ze-REM.
target: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

source: Ngama-REM ambalwa ebusuku, kulesi simo kulapho uthola khona ukulala kwangempela lapho umzimba wakho uzivuselela ngokwanele ukuthi ubhekane nezinkinga.
target: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

source: Lokhu kuyakhathalisa ngempela kwangathi bowuzovuka njalo ngemizuzu engamashumi amabili noma imizuzu engamashumi amathathu futhi ubukele i-TV.
target: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

source: Umphumela uxhomeke ekutheni ingqondo yakho izama kangakanani ukuphupha izwa ubusuku ngabunye.
target: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

source: Izinto aziwahambeli kahle amaNtaliyane eNyakatho Afrika cishe kusuka ekuqaleni. Phakathi neviki lokumemezela kweNtaliyane impi ngoJuni 10, 1940, amaBritish 11th Hussar ayethumbe iFort Capuzzo eLibya.
target: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

source: Ekuqamekeleni kwasempumalanga yeBardia, abaseBhrithani bathumba uNjiniyela Oyinhloko weButho Leshumi womNtaliyane, uJenene Lastucci.
target: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

source: Ngomhlaka 28 kuNhlangulana 28, u-Marshal Italo Balbo, uMbusi-Jikelele wase-Libya futhi obonakala eyindlalifa ka-Musolini, wabulawa ngephutha ngozakwabongenkathi efika e-Tobruk ngendiza.
target: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

source: Umdlalo wanamuhla we-fencing udlalwa emazingeni amaningi, kusukela ebafundini abafunda enyuvesi kuya kochwepheshe kanye nasekuncintisaneni kuma-Olimpiki.
target: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

source: Umdlalo ngokuyisisekelo udlalwa ngohlelo lomqhudelwano wokulwa ngezikhali, omunye eshaya omunye.
target: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

source: Igalufu umdlalo lapho abahlali besebenzisa izimuhluza ukushaya amabhola angene emigodini.
target: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

source: Imigodi eyishumi nesishiyagalombili idlalwa engxenyeni evamile, nabadlali ngokuvamile beqala emgodini wokuqala enkundleni futhi baqede koweshumi nesishiyagalombili.
target: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

source: Umdlali oshaya izikhathi ezincane kunabo bonke, noma ukushwiba kwesimuhluza, ukuze aqede umdlalo enkundleni uyawina.
target: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

source: Umdlalo udlalelwa otshanini, futhi utshani olungasemigodini busikwa bube bufishane futhi bubizwa nge-green.
target: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

source: Mhlawumbe uhlobo lokuvakasha oluvame kakhulu ilolo abantu abaningi abaluhlobanisa nokuthatha uhambo: Ukuvakasha Kokuzijabulisa.
target: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

source: Lapha yilapho abantu beya endaweni ehluke kakhulu kulokho abakwenza nsukuzonke ngokuvamile ukuze bayoncebeleka futhi bazijabulise.
target: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

source: Ambhishi, amapaki kanye namakhempu ayizindawo ngokuvamile ezivakashelwa izivakashi.
target: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

source: Uma inhloso yokuhambela komuntu endaweni ethile ukwazi umlando wawo namasiko ke lolu hlobo lwezokuvakasha luyaziwa njengokuvakasha ukuthi uyofunda amasiko.
target: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

source: Izivakashi zingavakashela izindawo zezwe elithize ezinkulu eziphawula izwe ezihlukahlukene noma zingakhetha ukugxila endaweni eyodwa.
target: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

source: Ama-Colonist, ebona lomsebenzi, nawo abiza ukuthi kuqiniswe.
target: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

source: Amasosha wokuqinisa izikhundla zangaphambili ayehlanganisa ibutho lokuqala nelesithathu lase-New Hampshire lamadoda angama-200, ngaphansi koKonela John Stark no-James Reed (bobabili kamuva baba ngojenene).
target: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

source: Abantu bakaStark baya endaweni esocingweni olusenyakatho kwendawo yabenzi bamaKoloni.
target: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

source: Uma ukuncipha kwamanzi kuvula isikhala ngaseMfuleni iMistiki ngasempumalanga nyakatho yenhlonhlo, banweba ngokushesha uthango ngodonga olumfishane lwamatshe ngasenyakatho oluphelela ngasekuqaleni kwamanzi ogwini oluncane.
target: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

source: UGridley noma uStark wabeka isigxobo esingamafidi angu-100 (30 m) phambi kocingo futhi wayala ukuthi kungabi nodubulayo kuze kube yilapho abantu abavamile besidlula.
target: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

source: Isu laseMelika lixhomeke ekuhlaseleni okuqondiswayo okusuka ezinhlangothini ezintathu ezihlukahlukene.
target: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

source: UJenene John Cadwalder wayezokwenza ukuhlasela kokulibazisa ngokumelene nebutho lamaBhrithani eBordentown, ukuze avimbe noma ikuphi ukuqinisa.
target: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

source: UJenene James Ewing ebengathatha amasosha angu-700 ngaphesheya komfula eTrenton Ferry, athathe ibhuloho eMfudlaneni i-Assunpink futhi avimbele amabutho wesitha ukuba abaleke.
target: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

source: Ibutho elihlaselayo eliyinhloko lamadoda angu-2,400 belizowela umfula amamayela ayisishiyagalolunye enyakatho neTrenton, bese alihlukanise libe amaqembu amabili, elinye ngaphansi kukaGreene futhi elinye ngaphansi kukaSullivan, ukuze ahlasele ngaphambi kwentathakusa.
target: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

source: Ngoshintsho kusuka engxenyeni yesine kuye engxenyeni yokusubatha kwemayela, isivinini siba esingabalulekile kakhulu futhi ukukhuthazela kuba isidingo ngokuphelele.
target: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

source: Yiqiniso umsubathi wengxenye yemayela osezingeni eliphezulu, indoda engasubatha ngemizuzu emibili, kumelwe ibe nejubane elihle, kodwa ukukhuthazela kumelwe kuhlakulelwe nakanjani.
target: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

source: Okunye ukugijima ezindaweni ezingavamile phakathi nobusika, kuhlanganiswe nokuzivivinya kokuqinisa imisipha namathambo engxenye engaphezulu yomzimba, ukuzilungiselela okuhle kwenkathi yokugijima.
target: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

source: Ukudla okunomsoco kukodwa angeke kukwenze wenze kahle, kodwa kungathinta inhlalakahle yabasubathi abasebasha kakhulu.
target: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

source: Ukunakekela ukulingana kwamandla empilo, ukuzijwayeza imikhuba emihle yokuphuza amanzi, kanye nokuqonda izici ezihlukahlukene zamaphilisi wamandla kungasiza abasubathi bathuthukise indlela abadlala ngayo futhi ithuthukise nenjabulo yabo emidlalweni.
target: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

source: Ukusubatha kwebanga eliphakathi umdlalo ongabizi kakhulu; nokho, kunemibono eyiphutha eminingi mayelana namathuzuli adingekayo ukuze uhlanganyele ekuncintisaneni.
target: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

source: Imikhiqizo ingathengwa ngokwesidingo sakho, kodwa eminingi izoba nokumbalwa noma ingabi namthelela otheni ekusebenzeni.
target: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

source: Abasubathi bangazizwa sengathi bathanda umkhiqizo ngisho noma ungenazo izinzuzo zangempela.
target: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

source: Ama-athomu mancane kakhulu ngendlela emangazayo kangangokuba ama-trillion awo angangena ku ngqi ekugcineni kwalomusho.
target: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

source: Yinto ekhona eyinkimbinkimbi ehlanganisa, ngokwesifanekiso sikaBohr esenziwe saba lula, i-nucleus emaphakathi ezungezwa ama-electron, okufana ngandlelathile nokuzungeza kwamapulanethi ilunga - bona Umfanekiso 1.1.
target: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

source: I-nucleus yenziwe ngezinhlayiyana ezimbili - ama-neutron kanye nama-proton.
target: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

source: Ama-phrothoni anamandla kagesi kuyilapho ama-nyuthroni engenawo amandla kagesi. Ama elekthroni anamandla kagesi angaphansi kweqanda ngenani.
target: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

source: Ukuhlola umuntu ohlukunyeziwe, a kufanele kuqalauhlole indawo yesehlakalo ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwakho.
target: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

source: Udinga ukubona indawo yesisulu njengoba usondela kuye nanoma yiziphi izimpawu eziyisixwayiso.
target: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

source: Uma ulimala uzama ukusiza, ungenza izinto zibe zibi nakakhulu nje kuphela.
target: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

source: Ucwaningo lubonise ukuthi ukucindezeleka, ukwesaba kanye nokubuka izinto njengenhlekelele kuqondisa ubuhlobo phakathi kobuhlungu nokukhubazeka kubantu abahlushwa ubuhlungo beqolo obusezansi.
target: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

source: Ukuphela komphumela wokubuka izinto zizimbi kunangendlela eziyiyo, hhayi ukucindezeleka futhi ukwasaba bekunombandela wemihlangano ye-PA yamaviki onke ehleliwe.
target: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

source: Labo abazibandakanya emisebenzini evamile badinga ukusekelwa okwengeziwe mayelana nokuzwa ubuhlungu, ubona umehluko phakathi kobuhlungu obungapheli kanye nokungaphatheki kahle okuvela ekunyakazeni komzimba.
target: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

source: Ukubona, noma ukukwazi ukubona kuncike ohlelweni lwezinzwa zokubona noma amehlo.
target: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

source: Kunokwakheka okuningi okuhlukile kwamehlo, okuhlukayo ngokuba inkimbinkimbi kuye ngezimfuneko zento ephilayo.
target: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

source: Izakhiwo ezingefani zinamakhono angefani, ziyezwela ezinhlobeni ezingefani zomoya futhi zinokukhalipha okungefani, futhi zidinga izindlela ezingefani zokusetshenziswa ukuze kuphumelele kanye nenani elingefani lomsebenzi.
target: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

source: Ubuningi iqoqo lezinto eziphilayo zohlobo oluthile phakathi nendawo ethile.
target: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

source: Lapho umuntu ngamunye efana nomunye ngesici esithile se-phenotype, baziwa ngokuthi ba-monomorphic.
target: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

source: Uma abantu ngabanye beveza izimfanelo ezihlukahlukene eziningana zesici esithile banezimo eziningi.
target: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

source: Ibutho lequlo lezintuthwane lihamba futhi lizalele ngezigaba ezahlukahlukene.
target: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

source: Esigabeni sokufuduka, amabutho ezintuthwane amasha ebusuku bese amise inkampu phakathi nosuku.
target: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

source: Ikoloni liqala isigaba sokuzulazula lapho ukudla okukhona kunciphile. Phakathi nalesi sigaba, ikoloni lenza izidleke zesikhashana ezishintshwa zinsuku zonke.
target: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

source: Lokhu kuvukela kwabazulazulayo ngakunye noma ukubhikisha kuthathe cishe izinsuku ezingu-17.
target: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

source: Liyini ingqamuzane? Igama elithi ingqamuzane liqhamuka kwelesi-Latin elithi “cella”, okusho “igumbi elincane”, futhi lasetshenziswa okokuqala uchwepheshe wokusebenzisa isibonakhulu ehlola indlela ukhokho owakheke ngayo.
target: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

source: Ingqamuzana isakhi esiyisekelo sazo zonke izinto eziphilayo, futhi zonke izinto eziphilayo zenziwe ngengqamuzana elilodwa noma amaningi.
target: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

source: Amangqamuzane ayisisekelo futhi abucayi ocwaningweni lwempilo, empeleni, kaningi kubhekiselwa kuwo njengokuthi "izakhi zokuphila".
target: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

source: Isimiso Sezinzwa sakha uzinzo ngokuthumela umuzwa wokufisa emzimbeni wonke ukuze ugcine umjikelezo wegazi uqhubeka ungaphazamiseki.
target: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

source: Le miyalezo yezinzwa engathunyelwa ngokushesha emzimbeni wonke esiza ekugcineni umzimba uphephile kunoma yini engaba usongo.
target: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

source: Izishingishane zigadla endaweni encane uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye iziphepho ezinamandla, kodwa zingabhubhisa yonke into esendleleni yazo.
target: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

source: Izishingishane zisiphula izihlahla, zidabule amabhodi ezindlini, ziphonse izimoto phezulu. Amaphesenti amabili wezishingishane ezibucayi kakhulu athatha ngaphezu kwamahora amathathu.
target: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

source: Isiphepho esikhulu esingakwayelekile besigijima ngesivinini sika-480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
target: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

source: Abantu babenza futhi basebenzisa izingilazi ukuze bakhulise izinto ezibukwayo izinkulungwane zezinkulungwane zeminyaka.
target: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

source: Nokho, ama-telescope okuqala angempela enziwa eYurophu ekupheleni kwekhulu lama-16 leminyaka.
target: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

source: Lawa matheleskobhu asebenzisa inhlanganisela yamalensi amabili ukwenza izinto ezikude zibonakale kokubili zisiduze futhi zizinkulu.
target: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

source: Ubugovu kanye nomhawu kuzohlala nathi ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi kuba khona lapho sifuna ukusebenzisana, lapho kuzuza khona abaningi kuzohlale kunokuningi ongakuzuza ngesikhathi esifushane ngokuba nomhawu
target: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

source: Ngokuthembisayo, abantu abaningi bazoqaphela ukuthi abangakukhetha okuhle kakhulu kwesikhathi eside ukusebenzisana nabanye.
target: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

source: Abantu abaningi baphupha ngosuku lapho beyokwazi ukuvakashela izinkanyezi baphinde babone neminye imihlaba, abanye bayazibuza ukuthi kunani lapha phezulu abanye bakholelwa ukuthi abantu bakwamanye amapulanethi noma ezinye izinhlobo zokuphila zingaphila kwelinye ipulanethi.
target: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

source: Kodwa, uma lokhu kuke kwenzeke cishe angeke kwenzeke isikhathi eside kakhulu. Izinkanyezi zisakazeke kakhulu kangangokuthi kunezigidigidikazi zamamayela bakwathi kwezinkanyezi "ezingomakhelwane".
target: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

source: Mhlawumbe ngolunye usuku, izizukulwane zakho zizobe zimi phezu kwezwe lwezidalwa ezivela komunye umhlaba zizibuza ngokhokho bazo bakudala?
target: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

source: Izilwane zenziwa amangqamuzana amaningi. Zidla izinto futhi zizigaye ngaphakathi. Izilwane ezingi ziyakwazi ukunyakaza.
target: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

source: Izilwane kuphela ezinobuchopho (nakuba kungezona zonke izilwane ezinabo; ama-jellyfish, ngokwesibonelo, awanabo ubuchopho).
target: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

source: Izilwane zitholakala yonke indawo emhlabeni. Zemba phansi, zibhukude ezilwandle, futhi zindize esibhakabhakeni.
target: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

source: Ingqamuzana ingxenye encane kunazo zonke engokwesakhiwo nesebenzayo yento ephilayo (izinto).
target: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

source: I-cell ivela egameni lesiLatin elithi cella elisho igumbi elincane.
target: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

source: Uma ubheka izinto eziphilayo ngesibona khulu, uzobona ukuthi zenziwe ngokusazikwele okuncane noma amabhola.
target: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

source: URobert Hooke, usobhayoloji waseNgilandi, wabona izikwele ezincane okhokhweni ngesibonakhulu.
target: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

source: Ayebukeka njengamakamelo. Wayengumuntu wokuqala wokuhlola amangqamuzana afile.
target: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

source: Ama-elementi kanye namakhompawundi angasuswa kwenye indawo ayiswe kwenye kodwa angashintshi.
target: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

source: I-nitrogen njengegesi isenezici ezifanayo ne-nitrogen ewuketshezi. Isimo soketshezi siyasinda kodwa amangqamuzana asafana.
target: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

source: Amanzi esinye isibonelo. Ingxube yamanzi yenziwe ama-athomu amabili we-hydrogen kanye ne-athomu elilodwa le-oxygen.
target: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

source: Anokwakhekwa kwengqamuzana okufanayo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ayigesi, uketshezi, noma aqinile.
target: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

source: Nakuba isimo sawo esingokoqobo singashintsha, isimo sawo samakhemikhali asiguquki.
target: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

source: Isikhathi into esizungezile sonke, futhi sithinta yonke into esiyenzayo, nokho kunzima ukusiqonda.
target: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

source: Isikhathi sitadishwe izazi zenkolo, zefilosofi, kanye nezesayensi izinkulungwane zeminyaka.
target: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

source: Sibona isikhathi njengezenzakalo eziwuchungechunge ezidlulayo zisuka esikhathini esizayo kuya kwesamanje kuya kwesedlule.
target: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

source: Isikhathi futhi siyindlela esiqhathanisa ngayo isikhathi (ubude) sezenzakalo.
target: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

source: Ungaphawula ukudlula kwesikhathi ngokwakho ngokubheka impinda yesenzakalo somjikelozo. Isenzakalo somjikelezo yinto eyenzeka ngokuphindaphindiwe ngokuvamile.
target: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

source: Amakhompyutha namuhla asetshenziselwa ukusebenza ngezithombe namavidiyo.
target: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

source: Opopayi abayinkimbinkimbi bangenziwa ngamakhompyutha, futhi lolu hlobo lopopayi lusetshenziswa ngokwandayo kuthelevishini nakumafilimu.
target: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

source: Umculo kaningi urekhodwa kusetshenziswa amakhompyutha ayinkimbinkimbi ukusebenzisa kanye nokuhlanganisa imisindo ndawonye.
target: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

source: Isikhathi eside phakathi namakhulu eminyaka eshumi nesishiyagalolunye kanye namashumi amabili, bekukholelwa ukuthi abahlali bokuqala baseNyuzilandi abantu baseMaori, ababezingela izinyoni ezinkulu ezibizwa ngama-moa.
target: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

source: Umcabango wakha umbono wokuthi abantu bama-Maori basuke ePholinesiya ngeMikhumbi Eminingi futhi bathathela ama-Mariori iNyuzilandi, bamisa umphakathi wokulima.
target: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

source: Nokho, ubufakazi obusha busikisela ukuthi ama-Moriori bekuyiqembu labantu basezwekazini laseMaori abathuthe besuka eNyuzilandi beya eZiqhingini zaseChatham, bezenzela isiko labo elihlukile, elinokuthula.
target: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

source: Bekunesinye futhi isizwe eziqhingini zase-Chatham laba bekungama-Maori abathuthe besuka eNyuzilandi.
target: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

source: Babezibiza ama-Moriori bekunabantu abathanda ukulwa abambalwa futhi ekugcineni, ama-Moriori abhujiswa.
target: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

source: Abantu ngabanye abahilelekile amakhulu eminyaka amaningana basisize sazise amakhono ethu nesikuthandayo kuyilapho sihlola bobuqotho ubunzima ngisho nokwehluleka.
target: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

source: Ngenkathi silalele abantu ngabanye besitshela izindaba zabo, zomndeni, kanye nezenhlangano, sithole ukuqonda okubalulekile kwesikhathi esidlule kanye nabanye babantu abathonye isiko lenhlangano ngendlela enhle noma embi.
target: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

source: Nakuba ukuzwisisa umlando womuntu kungasho ukuzwisisa isiko lomuntu, okungenani kusiza abantu babe nomuzwa wokuthi bawela kuphi emlandweni wenhlangano.
target: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

source: Uma bebhekisisa impumelelo futhi uqaphela ukuhluleka, abantu ngabanye kanye nabo bonke abantu ababambe iqhaza bathola ngokujulileizinkolelo, imigomo, kanye nezinto ezishukumisa le nhlangano.
target: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

source: Kulesi simo, ukukhumbula izimo ezidlule zokuziphatha kwezamabhizinisi kanye nempumelelo ebakhona kwasiza abantu bamukele izinguquko kanye nendlela entsha yesonto lendawo.
target: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

source: Izindaba ezinjalo zempumelelo zanciphisa ukwesaba ushintsho, zibe zenza ukuthambekela okuhle oshintshweni lwesikhathi esizayo.
target: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

source: Izindlela zokucabanga ezihlelwe kahle ziyisisxazululo sezinkinga esihlanganisa imibono ehlukahlukene noma izindawo ukuze zithole isixazululo.
target: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

source: Ukugxila kwalomcabango isivinini, ingqondo kanye nokunemba, futhi nokuphawulwa kwamaqinisio, ukusebenzisa kabusha izindlela ezikhona, ukuqongelela ukwaziswa.
target: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

source: Isici esibaluleke kakhulu salomcabango ukuthi: kunempendulo eyodwa kuphela enembile. Ucabanga ngezimpendulo ezimbili kuphela, okungukuthi enembile nenganembile.
target: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

source: Lolu hlobo lokucabanga lihlotshaniswa nohlobo oluthile lwesayensi noma izindlela ezithile ezisezingeni.
target: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

source: Abantu abanalolu hlobo lokucabanga bacabanga ngendlela enengqondo, bayakwazi ukubamba izifanekiso ngekhanda, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izivivinyo zesayensi.
target: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.
