source: Abantu izidalwa ezinekhono elidlula elezinye lokufunda izingqondo zabanye.
target: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

source: Lokhu kusho ukuthi siyakwazi ukubikezela ngokuphumelelayo lokho abanye abantu abakubonayo, abakuhlelayo, abakukholelwayo, abakwaziyo kanye nabakufisayo.
target: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

source: Phakathi kwalawa makhono, ukuqonda inhloso yabanye kubalulekile. Kusivumela ukuxazilula izindida ezingaba khona zezenzo ezingokoqobo.
target: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

source: Ngokwesibonelo, uma ubona umuntu ephula iwindi lemoto, ngokuvamile ungacabanga ukuthi ubefuna ukweba imoto yomuntu ongamazi.
target: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

source: Wayezodinga ukwahlulelwa ngokuhlukile uma ngabe wayelahle izikhiye zemoto yakhe futhi bekuyimoto yakhe ayezama ukuyigqekeza.
target: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

source: I-MRI isuselwa esenzakalweni sesayensi esibizwa nge-nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), eyatholwa ngawo-1930 ngu-Felix Bloch (owayesebenza eNyuvesi yase-Stanford) kanye no-Edward Purcell (waseNyuvesi yase-Havard).
target: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

source: Kulommemo, amandla kazibuthe kanye namava omsakazo abangela ama-athomu ukukhipha izimpawu zemisebe ezincane.
target: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

source: Ngonyaka ka-1970, uRaymond Damadian, udokotela wezokwelapha kanye nososayensi wocwaningo, uthole isisekelo sokusebenzisa izithombe zommemo kazibuthe njengethuluzi lokucilonga kwezokwelapha.
target: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

source: Iminyaka emine kamuva incwadi yemvume yanikezwa, okwakuyincwadi yemvume yokuqala emhlabeni enikezwe enkundleni yeMRI.
target: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

source: Ngo-1977, uDkt. Damadian waqeda ukwakha iskena se-MRI "somzimba ophelele", asibiza ngokuthi “Esingenakunqotshwa”.
target: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

source: Ukukhulumisana okungenzeki ngasikhathi sinye kukhuthaza isikhathi sokucabangisisa kanye nokusabela kwabanye.
target: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

source: Kunika abafundi ikhono lokusebenza ngejubane labo futhi balawule ijubane lokwaziswa kokufundisa.
target: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

source: Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunokukhawulelwa kwesikhathi okumbalwa ngethuba lamahora okusebenza avumelana nezimo. (Bremer, 1998)
target: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

source: Ukusetshenziswa kwe-inthanethi neWebhu Yomhlaba Jikelele kuvumela abafundi ukuthi bakwazi ukuthola ukwaziswa abakudingayo ngaso sonke isikhathi.
target: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

source: Abafunda bangabuye bakwazi ukuthumela imibuzo kubafundisi nganoma isiphi isikhathi sosuku futhi balindele ukusabela cishe okusheshayo, kunokulinda umhlangano wobuso nobuso olandelayo.
target: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

source: Indlela yesimanje yokufunda inikeza inkululeko ezintweni ezingenamkhawulo. Ayikho indlela eyodwa kuphela yokufunda.
target: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

source: Eqinisweni, akuyona eyodwa into umuntu okumele ayifunde. Ukufunda kudinga ulwazi phakathi komfundi nalolo lwazi olusuke lunikezwa.
target: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

source: Ulwazi lethu esinalo lokuzenzela izinto nokukhuluma ngokwaziswa, izinhlelo zethelevishini ezisekelwe ekufundeni ziveza leli phuzu.
target: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

source: Iningi lethu sizithola sibukele izinhlelo zethelevishini ezisitshela ngenqubo noma into eyenzekayo esingeke sihlanganyele kuyo noma sisebenzise lolo lwazi.
target: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

source: Angeke silungise imoto, sakhe umthombo emuva kwegceke, sithathe uhambo oluya ePheru ukuyohlola amanxiwa akudala, noma silungise indlu kamakhelwane wethu.
target: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

source: Ngenxa yokuxhumana kwekhebuli enemicu yokudlulisa ukukhaya ehamba ngaphansi kolwandle nesiphuphutheki sokuxhumanisa, i-Greenland uxhumene kahle nabantu abangu-93% abanoxhumano lwe-inthanethi.
target: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

source: Ihhotela lakho noma umbungazi (uma uhlala endlini yezivakashi noma ikhaya lomuntu) cishe uzoba ne-wifi noma ikhompyutha exhunywe kuyi-inthanethi, futhi zonke izindawo zinezitolo ze-inthanethi noma izindawo ze-wifi zomphakathi.
target: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

source: Njengoba kushiwo ngenhla, nakuba igama elithi "Eskimo" lihlala lamukelekile eMelika, lithathwa njengokweyisa abantu abaningi abangahlali eMelika base-Arctic, ikakhulukazi eCanada.
target: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

source: Nakuba ungezwa leli gama lisetshenziswa abantu Bendabuko baseZweni Eliluhlaza, kumelwe ligwenywe abantu bakwamanye amazwe.
target: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

source: Abahlali bendabuko baseGreenland bazibiza ngokuthi Inuit eCanada nokuthi Kalaalleq (ubuningi Kalaallit), umuntu waseGreenland, eGreenland.
target: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

source: Ubugebengu kanye nokuphatha kabi abakwamanye amazwe ngokujwayelekile, kuyinto engaziwa e-Greenland. Kanti nasemadolobheni, azikho “izindawo ezinodlame.”
target: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

source: Isimo sezulu esibandayo cishe yiyo kuphela ingozi engokoqobo abangazilungiselele abazohlangabezana nayo.
target: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

source: Uma uvakashela iZwe Eliluhlaza ngenkathi ebandayo (ngokubona ukuthi uma uya enyakatho nakakhulu, kuya kubanda), kubalulekile ukuphatha okokugqoka okufudumele ngokwanele.
target: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

source: Izinsuku ezinde kakhulu ehlobo zingaholela ezinkingeni zokulala ngokwanele futhi zihlotshaniswa nezinkinga zempilo.
target: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

source: Phakathi nehlobo, qaphela omiyane base-Nordic. Nakuba bengadlulisi noma iziphi izifo, bangacasula.
target: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

source: Noma umnotho wase-San Francisco uxhumane nawo njengendawo ethandwa yizivakashi emhlabeni wonke, umnotho wayo uyingxubevange.
target: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

source: Umkhakha womsebenzi omkhulu kakhulu izinkonzo zobuchwepheshe, uhulumeni, ezemali, ezokwehweba, kanye nezokuvakasha.
target: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

source: Ukubukiswa kwalo njalo emculweni, kumafilimu, ezincwadini kanye nasemasikweni athandwayo kwenze idolobha kanye nezici ezibonwa ngalo izwe zaziwe emhlabeni wonke.
target: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

source: I-San Francisco izungezwe izakhiwo ezinkulu zezivakashi ezinamahhotela amaningi, izitolo zokudlela, kanye nezakhiwo zemihlangano ezisezingeni eliphezulu.
target: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

source: eSan Francisco nayo ingenye yezindawo ezinhle kunazo zonke esizweni sokupheka ezinye izinto zase-Eshiya: iKorea, iThai, iNdiya, neJapan
target: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

source: Ukuvakashela e-Walt Disney World kumelela uhambo olukhulu lokuya endaweni engcwele emindenini eminingi yaseMelika.
target: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

source: Ukuvakasha “okuvamile” kuhlanganisa ukundiza uye eSikhumulweni seziNdiza seZizwe Zonke sase-Orlando, ukuthatha ibhasi eliya ehhotela elise-Disney, ukuchitha isikhathi esingangesonto ngaphandle kokuphuma endaweni yase-Disney, kanye nokubuyela ekhaya.
target: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

source: Ziningi Izinto ongakhetha kuzona, kodwa lokhu kuhlala kuyilokho abantu abakushoyo uma bekhuluma "ngokuya e-Disney World."
target: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

source: Amathikithi amaningi adayiswa nge-inthanethi ngezingosi zezindali njenge-eBay noma i-Craigslist asatshenziswa njengamathikithi okuya emapaki amaningi ngezinsuku eziningi.
target: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

source: Nakuba kuwumsebenzi ovamile kakhulu, wenqatshelwe yi-Disney: amathikithi awadluliselwa.
target: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

source: Noma ikuphi ukukanisa onqenqemeni lweGrand Canyon kufuna imvume yasezintabeni.
target: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

source: Izimvume zinginganiselwe ukuze kuvikelwe izindonga ezinkulu ezenziwa umfula, futhi zitholakala ngokusuku lokuqala lwenyanga, izinyanga ezine ngaphambi kokuqala kwenyanga.
target: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

source: Ngakho-ke, imvume yasezintabeni yanoma iluphi usuku lokuqalisa ngoMeyi itholakala ngo-1 Jan.
target: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

source: Indawo ezindaweni ezijwayeleke kakhulu, njenge-Bright Angel Campground eseduze kwe-Phantom Ranch, ngokuvamile egwaliswa izicelo ezitholakale ngosuku lokuqala kuvuliwe.
target: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

source: Kunenani elilinganiselwe lezimvume ezibekelwe izicelo zabafika kungahleliwe ezitholakala kulabo abafike kuqala.
target: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

source: Ukungena e-Afrika eseNingizimu kuyindlela amangalisayo yokubona ubuhle bendawo kanye nokuya ezindaweni ezingekho emzileni wezivakashi ovamile.
target: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

source: Lokhu kungenzeka emotweni ejwayelekile uma uhlela ngokucophelela kodwa i-4x4 iyona okutuswa ukuthi uyisebenzise kakhulu futhi ungakwazi ukufinyelela ezindaweni eziningi nge-4x4 enamasondo aphakeme kuphela.
target: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

source: Ukukhumbula njengoba uhlela ukuthi nakuba i-Afrika eseNingizimu igxilile akuwona wonke amazwe angomakhelwane anjalo.
target: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

source: Izimfuneko ze-visa nezindleko kuyahluka emazweni ngamazwe futhi kuthonywa yizwe ovela kulo.
target: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

source: Izwe ngalinye libuye libe nemithetho ehlukile edinga okumelwe kube yizinto zesimo esiphuthumayo okumelwe zibe semotweni.
target: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

source: IMpophoma iVictoria idolobha elisengxenyeni esentshonalanga yaseZimbabwe, ngaphesheya komkhawulo kusuka eTsheni Eliphilayo, eZambia futhi eduze naseBotswana.
target: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

source: Idolobha lakheke eduze kwezimpophoma, futhi ziheha kakhulu, futhi lendawo ethandwayo yezivakashi inikeza kokubili abathandi benjabulo kaye nabathandi bendalo ithuba lokuhlala isikhathi eside.
target: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

source: Ngesikhathi semvula (Novemba ukuya kuMashi), izinga lamanzi lizobaphezulu futhi iZimpophoma zizoba namandla kakhulu.
target: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

source: Uyaqinisekiswa ukuthi uzoba manzi uma uwela ibhuloho noma uhamba emizileni eseduze neMpophoma.
target: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

source: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kungenxa nje yokuthi amanzi akhona maningi kangangokuba ukubona iMpophoma ngokwayo kuzositheka—yiwo wonke amanzi!
target: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

source: Ithuna likaTutankhamun (KV62). I-KV63 kungaba yithuna elidume kakhulu eSigodini, indawo yomvubukulo ka-Howard Carter wango-1992 wethuna cishe elisahlangene lasebukhosini lenkosi esencane.
target: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

source: Uma liqhathaniswa namanye amathuna wasebukhonsini, ithuna likaTutankhamun, kepha, cishe akubalulekanga ukulivakashela, njengoba lilincane kakhudlwana futhi linemihlobiso elinganiselwe.
target: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

source: Noma ubani onesithakazelo sokubona ubufakazi bomonakalo owenzeke esidumbwini esomiswe ngemithi ngenkathi kuzanywa ukusisusa ebhokisini lomngcwabo uzodumala njengoba kubonakala ikhanda namahlombe kuphela.
target: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

source: Ingcebo emangalisayo yethuna ayisekho kulo, kodwa iyiswe eMnyuziyamu yaseGibhithe e-Khayiro.
target: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

source: Izivakashi ezinesikhathi esilinganiselwe zingenza kahle ukuchitha isikhathi sazo kwenye indawo.
target: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

source: I-Phnom Krom, engu-12 km eningizimu ntshonalanga yeSiem Reap. Leli thempeli eliphezu kwegquma lakhiwa ekugcineni kwekhulu lama-9 leminyaka, phakathi nokubusa kweNkosi uYasovarman.
target: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

source: Isimo sokungabi nathemba sethempeli kanye nokubona indawo ngaphezu kwechibi leTonle Sap kwenza ukugibela igqube kufanelwe umzamo.
target: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

source: Ukuvakashela indawo kungahlanganiswa ngokufanelekile nohambo lwesikebhe lokuya echibini.
target: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

source: Indawo Yokudlula yase-Angkor iyadingeka ukuze ungene ethempelini ngakho ungakhohlwa ukuza nephasiphothi yakho uma uya eTonle Sap.
target: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

source: IJerusalema inhlokodolobha futhi idolobha elikhulu kunawo wonke lakwa-Israyeli, nakuba amanye amazwe amaningi neZizwe Ezihlangene zingayiqapheli njengenhlokodolobha yakwa-Israyeli.
target: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

source: Idolobha lamandulo eMagqumeni aseJudiya linomlando othakazelisayo oneminyaka eyizinkulungwane.
target: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

source: Idolobha lingcwele ezinkolweni ezintathu ezikholelwa kuNkulunkulu oyedwa – ubuJuda, ubuKhristu kanye nobuSulumani, futhi liyisikhungo esingokomoya, esingokwenkolo, kanye nesingokwesiko.
target: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

source: Ngenxa yokubaluleka okungokwenkolo kwedolobha, futhi ngokukhethekile izindawo eziningi zendawo yeDolobha Lakudala, iJerusalema ingenye yezindawo eziyinhloko izivakashi eziya kuyo kwa-Israyeli.
target: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

source: IJerusalema linezindawo eziningi zomlando, zemivubukulo kanye nezamasiko kuhlanganise nezindawo zokuthenga ezinhle neziphithizelayo, amakhefi kanye nezindawo zokudlela.
target: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

source: I-Ecuador ilindele ukuthi izakhamuzi zase-Cuba zithole incwadi yesimemo ngaphambi kokungena e-Ecuadore ngezikhululo zezindiza zakwamanye amazwe noma izindawo zokungena ezisephethelweni.
target: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

source: Lencwadi kumelwe yenziwe ibe semthethweni yi-Ecuadore Ministry of Foreign Affairs, futhi yenze ngokuvumelana nezicelo ezidingekayo.
target: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

source: Lezi zidingo zakhelwe ukunikeza indlela ehlelekile yokuthutha phakathi kwamazwe womabili.
target: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

source: Izakhamuzi zaseCuba ezinemvume yokuhlala nokusebenza eMelika kumelwe zivakashele Inxusa lase-Ecuadore ukuze zithole ukukhululwa kulemfuneko.
target: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

source: Iphasiphoti yakho kumelwe ibe semthethweni okungenani izinyana ezingu-6 ngaphezu kwezinsuku zakho zohambo. Ithikithi lokuya nokubuya liyadingeka ukufakazela ubude besikhathi ozosihlala.
target: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

source: Ukuvakasha kushibhile emaqenjini amakhulu, ngakho uma uzimele noma unomngane oyedwa, zama ukuhlangana nabanye abantu ukuze nakhe iqembu labantu abane noma abasithupha ukuze nithole amanani aphansi omuntu oyedwa.
target: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

source: Nokho, lokhu akumelwe kukukhathaze, ngoba kaningi izivakashi ziyiswa ngapha nangapha ukugcwalisa izimoto.
target: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

source: Kubonakala empeleni kuyindlela yokuyengela abantu ekucabangeni ukuthi kumelwe bakhokhele okwengeziwe.
target: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

source: Ime ngaphezu kwengxenye esenyakatho yeMachu Picchu yilentaba ewummango, kaningi okuyindawo evelayo ngemuva ezithombeni zamanxiwa.
target: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

source: Kubukeka kusabisa kancane kusuka ngaphansi, futhi yindawo eyehlelayo nokunzima ukukhuphuka kuyo, kodwa abantu abakulungele ngokwanele kufanele bakwazi ukukwenza cishe ngemizuzu engama-45.
target: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

source: Izitebhisizamatshe zibekwa eceleni kwendlela, futhi ezingxenyeni ezinomqansa izintambo zensimbi ziba uthango lokubambelelisa izandla .
target: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

source: Nokho, lindela ukuphelelwa umoya, futhi uziqaphele ezingxenyeni ezehlelayo, ikakhulukazi lapho kumanzi, njengoba kungaba yingozi ngokushesha.
target: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

source: Kunomhume omncane eduze nesiqongo okumelwe kudlulwe kuwo, usezansi kakhulu futhi uminyene.
target: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

source: Ukubona izindawo kanye nezilwane zasendle zamaGalapago kwenzeka kahle kakhulu ngesikebhe, njengoba nje uCharles Darwin enza ngo-1835.
target: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

source: Imikhumbi yokuvakasha engaphezu kuka-60 igwedla emanzini wamaGalapago - ihluka ngobukhulu kusukela kwegibeza abantu abangu-8 kuya ku-100.
target: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

source: Abantu abaningi babhukha indawo yabo kusenesikhathi (njengoba izikebhe ziyaye zisheshe ukugcwala ngezikhathi ezimatasa zonyaka).
target: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

source: Qinisekisa ukuthi umuntu okubhukelayo unguchwepheshe wamaGalapago onalwazi oluhle lwezinhlobonhlobo eziningi zemikhumbi.
target: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

source: Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi onesithakazelo kukho ngokukhethekile kanye/noma okukucindezelayo kuhambisana nomkhumbi okufanele kakhulu.
target: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

source: Ngaphambi kokuba kufike abantu baseSpeyini ngekhulu lama-16 leminyaka, iChile esenyakatho beyingaphansi kokubusa kwama-Inca kuyilapho ama-Araucania wendabuko (Mapuche) ayehlala eChile ephakathi neseningizimu.
target: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

source: Ama-Mapuche bekungamanye wamaqembu omdabu azimele wokugcina waseMelika, ababengangenanga ngokugcwele emthethweni wokukhuluma isiPanishi ngemva kokuzimela kwe-Chile.
target: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

source: Nakuba i-Chile yamemezela ukuzimela ngo-1810 (phakathi kwezimpi zikaNapholiyoni ezashiya iSpeyini ngaphandle kohulumeni omkhulu iminyaka embalwa), ukunqoba abantu baseSpeyini okungumnqamulajuqu akwenzekanga kwaze kwaba ngu-1818.
target: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

source: i-Dominican Republic (iSpanish: República Dominicana) iyisizwe sase-Caribbean esisengxenyeni esempumalanga yesiqhingi sase-Hispaniola, eyabelana ne-Haiti
target: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

source: Ngaphandle kwezihlabathi ezimhlophe zolwandle kanye nezindawo ezinezintaba, lelizwe liyikhaya ledolobha elidala kunawo wonke laseYurophu kuma-Americas, manje okuyingxenye yeSanto Domingo.
target: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

source: Esiqhingini ekuqaleni bekuhlala ama-Taíno namaCaribe. AmaCaribe bekungabantu abakhuluma isi-Arawaka abafike ngawo-10,000 BCE.
target: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

source: Phakathi neminyaka embalwa ngemva kokufika kwezinhloli zaseYurophu, inani labantu baseTainos lehliswe ngokuphawulekayo abanqobi baseSpeyini
target: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

source: Ngokusekelwe kuFray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) phakathi kuka-1492 no-1498 abanqobi baseSpeyini babulala ama-Taíno acishe abe ngu-100,000.
target: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

source: I-Jardín de la Unión. Lesi sikhala sakhiwa njengegceke lesonto ngekhulu le-17, lapho i-Templo de San Diego eyisakhiwo esasindayo kuphela.
target: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

source: Manje isebenza njengesigcawu esiyinhloko edolobheni, futhi ihlala inezinto eziningi ezenzekayo, emini nasebusuku.
target: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

source: Kunezitolo zokudlela eziningana ezizungeze ingadi, futhi emini nasentambama lapho amakhonsati wamahhala avame ukunikezwa kusuka etendeni eliyinhloko.
target: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

source: I-Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Ovulanda ababili abahlukaniswe amasentimitha angu-69 kuphela ikhaya lenganekwana yakudala yothando.
target: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

source: Ngemadlana ezinye izingane zizokuzekela indaba.
target: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

source: ISiqhingi sase-Bowen uhambo losuku oluthandwayo noma uhambo lokungcebeleka lwempelasonto oluhlanganisa izikebhe ezigwedlwayo, ukuqwala izintaba, izitolo, izindawo zokudlela, kanye nokunye.
target: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

source: Lo mphakathi wangempela use-Howe Sound ekuceleni nje kwe-Vancouver, futhi ungaya kuso kalula ngetikisi yasemanzini ehleliwe esuka esiQhingini saseGrandville phakathi edolobheni lase-Vancouver.
target: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

source: Kulabo abajabulela imisebenzi yangaphandle, umzila oya emhubheni weSea to Sky ubalulekile.
target: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

source: IWhistler (uhambo lwamahora angu-1.5 uma ushayela kusuka eVancouver) iyabiza kodwa iyaziwa kakhulu ngenxa yama-Olimpiki aseBusika ango-2010.
target: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

source: Uma kusebusika, ungathokokozela ukushushuluza eqhweni eNyakatho Melika, futhi uma kusehlobo ungazama ukuzijabulisa ngokuqombola izintaba ngamabhayisikili kwangempela.
target: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

source: Izimvume kumelwe zitholwe kusengaphambili. Kumelwe ube nemvume yokuhlala ubusuku bonke eSirena.
target: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

source: ISirena yiso kuphela isiteshi sabanakekeli bamahlathi esinezindawo zokulala zamakamelo alala abantu abaningi nokudla okushisayo ngaphezu kokukanisa. ILa Leona, iSan Pedrillo, kanye neLos Patos zihlinzeka ngokukanisa kuphela ngaphandle kwezinkonzo zokudla.
target: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

source: Kuyenzeka ukuthola izimvume zepaki ngokuqondile Esiteshi Somphathi Wendawo ePuerto Jiménez, kodwa abemukeli wonke amakhadi wokuthenga ngesikweletu
target: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

source: I-The Park Service (MINAE) ayihlinzeki ngezimvume zokupaka uma kusasele isikhathi esingaphezu kwenyanga eyodwa ngaphambi kosuku ozofika ngalo.
target: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

source: i-CafeNet El Sol inikezela ngamasevisi okubhuka ngemali engu- US$30, noma u- $10 ngokudlula kosuku olulodwa; imininingwane isekhasini labo le-Corcovado.
target: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

source: Iziqhingi zoMpheki isiqhingi esiyizwe elizihlanganise ngokuzithandela neNyuzilandi, ezisePholinesiya, phakathi Nolwandlekazi iNingizimu Phasifiki.
target: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

source: Yidlanzana leziqhingi elineziqhingi ezingu-15 ezisabalele endaweni eyizigidi ezingu-2.2 km2 zolwandle.
target: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

source: Ngesikhathi sendawo esifana nesaseHawaii, iziqhingi ngezinye izikhathi zithathwa "njengeziseHawaii".
target: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

source: Noma iyincane, ikhumbuza izivakashi ezikhulile i-Hawaii ngaphambi kokumiswa njengombuso ngaphandle kwamahhotela amakhulu wezivakashi kanye nezinye izakhiwo.
target: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

source: IziQhingi zaseCook azinawo noma imaphi amadolobha kodwa zenziwe yiziqhingi ezingu-15 ezihlukahlukene. Eziyinhloko iRarotong kanye ne-Aitutaki.
target: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

source: Emazweni aphucukile namuhla, ahlinzeka ngezindawo zokulala nokudla kwasekuseni kwenziwa kwaba indlela ethile yobuciko
target: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

source: Ezingeni eliphezulu, amaB&B ngokusobala ancintisana ngezinto ezimbili eziyinhloko: indawo yokulala nokudla kwasekuseni.
target: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

source: Ngakho-ke, ezindaweni ezihle kakhulu umuntu kufanele athole izinto zokulala zikanokusho, mhlawumbe ingube yokwendlala eyenziwe ngezandla noma umbhede wasendulo.
target: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

source: Ukudla kwasekuseni kungahlanganisa ukudla okumnandi kwasendaweni kwenkathi ethile yonyaka noma isidlo esikhethekile sombungazi.
target: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

source: Indawo ingaba esakhiweni sakudala esingokomlando esinempahla yamandulo, izingadi ezilungiswe kahle kanye nechibi lokubhukuda.
target: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

source: Ukungena emotweni yakho bese uya ohambweni olude kunokuthandeka okungokoqobo kanye nokuba lula kwakho.
target: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

source: Ngokungafani nezimoto ezinkulu ngokuqinisekile usujwayelene nokushayela imoto yakho futhi uyakwazi ukulinganisela kwayo.
target: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

source: Ukumisa itende endaweni enomnikazi noma edolobheni lanoma ibuphi ubukhulu kungabanga ukunakwa okungafunwa.
target: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

source: Kafuphi, ukusebenzisa imoto yakho indlela ekahle kakhulu yokuthatha uhambo olude kodwa akuvamanga ukuthi kube yindlela “yokukanisa”.
target: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

source: Ukukanisa emotweni kungenzeka lapho uneveni encane, i-SUV, iSedan noma iStation Wagon esinezihlalo ezikwazi ukulala.
target: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

source: Amanye amahhotela anefa elisuka enkathini yokuchuma yezitimela nemikhumbi ehamba ngamalahle; ngaphambi kweMpi Yomhlaba Yesibili, ngekhulu lama-19 noma ekuqaleni kwelama-20 leminyaka.
target: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

source: Lawa mahhotela bekuyilapho abacebile nabadumile bangaleyo nkathi ababehlala khona, futhi kaningi ayenokuhla okuphambili nezenzakalo zasebusuku.
target: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

source: Izindlela zakudala zokugqoka, kanye nokwentuleka kwezakamuva futhi nendlela ethokozisayo abakhula ngayo iveza ububona.
target: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

source: Nakuba zinabanikazi ngokuvamile, kwesinye isikhathi zihlalisa iziphathimandla nezinye izikhulu.
target: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

source: Umhambi onemali eningi angacabangela uhambo lwendiza oluzungeza umhlaba wonke, olunqunywe ngokuhlala kwamaningi wamahotela lawa.
target: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

source: I-hospitality exchange network inhlangano ehlanganisa izihambi nabantu bendawo emadolobheni eziyowavakashela.
target: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

source: Ukujoyina inethiweki enjalo ngokuvamile kudinga nje ukugcwalisa ifomu eku-inthanethi; nakuba amanye amanethiweki anikeza noma adinga ukudinisekiswa.
target: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

source: Uhlu lwababungazi abatholakalayolinikezwa ngokushicilelwa kanye/noma ku-inthanethi, kwesinye isikhathi nezinkomba kanye nokubuyekezwa kwabanye abahambi.
target: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

source: I-couchsurfing yasungulwa ngoJanuwari 2004 ngemva kokuba umlobi wezinhlelo zokusebenza zekhompyutha uCasey Fenton athole indiza engabizi yokuya e-Iceland kodwa engenayo indawo yokuhlala.
target: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

source: Wathumela abafundi benyuvesi yendawo ama-imeyili futhi wathola inani elimangalisayo labantu ababefuna ukumnika indawo yokuhlala mahhala.
target: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

source: Amahostela ahlalisa abantu abasha ngokuyinhloko – isivakashi esivamile siseminyakeni yamashumi amabili – kodwa ungathola nezihambi ezindala kaningi.
target: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

source: Imindeni enabantwana ayijwayelekile, kodwa amanye amahostela ayayivumela emakamelweni wangasese.
target: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

source: Idolabha laseBeijing eShayina lizokwengamela Imidlalo yama-Olimpikhi Asebusika ngo-2022, nokuzoyenza idolabha lokuqala lokubungaza yomibili imidlalo yama-Olimpikhi yasebusika nasehlobo.
target: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

source: I-Beijing izobungaza imicimbi yokuvula neyokuvala kanye nemidlalo yeqhwa yangaphakathi.
target: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

source: Ezinye izehlakalo zokushushuluza eqhweni zizoba sendaweni yase-Taizicheng yokushushuluza eqhweni e-Zhangjiakou, cishe ama-220 km (140 amamayela) kusuka eBeijing.
target: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

source: Iningi lamathempeli linawo umkhosi Waminyaka Yonke oqala ekupheleni kukaNovemba kuya Phakathi kukaMeyi, okuhluka kuya ngekhalenda laminyaka yonke lethempeli ngalinye.
target: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

source: Iningi lemikhosi yethempeli ligujwa njengengxenye yesikhumbuzo sethempeli noma ukugujwa kosuku lokuzalwa likankulunkulu ophethe.
target: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

source: Imikhosi yasethempelini laseKerala iyathakazelisa kakhulu ukuyibona, kanye nokumasha kwezindlovu ezihlotshisiwe, iqembu le-orchestra lethempeli neminye imikhosi.
target: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

source: IWorld's Fair (ngokuvamile ebizwa World Exposition, noma kalula i-Expo) umkhosi omkhulu kunayo yonke wamazwe onke wobuciko nesayensi.
target: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

source: Amazwe athathe ingxenye abemele amaciko kanye nemfundo ebonakaliswa ezindaweni zikazwelonke ukubonisa izinkinga zomhlaba wonke noma isiko lezwe labo kanye nomlando.
target: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

source: Ama-International Horticultural Exposition ezenzakalo ezikhethekile ezikhangisa ngezimbali, izingadi zezimbali kanye nanoma yini ehlangene nezitshalo.
target: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

source: Nakuba ngokubonwa ngokucabanga zingenzeka njalo ngonyaka (uma nje zisemazweni ahlukile), ngokoqobo akunjalo.
target: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

source: Lezi zenzakalo ngokuvamile zithatha esikhathi esiphakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu kanye neziyisithupha, futhi zibanjelwa ezindaweni okungenani ezingamahektare angu-50
target: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

source: Kunezinhlobo eziningi zamafilimu ebezisentshenziswa kule minyaka edlule. Evamile ifilimu ingu-35 mm (36 uphindaphiwe ka-24 mm) iwona abevamile.
target: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

source: Ngokuvamile kugcwaliseka futhi kalula kakhulu uma uphelelwa, futhi inikeza okubukeka okulinganiselwa kulokho okukhona kwe-DSLR.
target: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

source: Amanye amakhamera wamafilimi wohlobo oluphakathi asebenzisa ifomethi ye-6 ngo-6, ngokunembile kakhudlwana inegethivu ka-56 ngo-56 mm.
target: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

source: Lokhu kunikeza ukubonakala cishe okuyizikhathi ezine kunenegethivu ka-35 mm (3136mm2 kuqhathaniswa ne-864) .
target: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

source: Izilwane zasendle umhlobiso wezithombe olukhuni kakhulu kwabathatha izithombe, futhi udinga inhlanganisela yenhlanhla, isineke, ulwazi kanye namathuluzi akahle.
target: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

source: Ukuthatha izithombe kwezilwane zasendle kaningi kuthathwa kalula, kodwa njengokuthatha izithombe okuvamile, isithombe sisho okuningi kakhulu.
target: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

source: Ukuthatha amafotho wasendle ngokuvamile kudinga ilensi yamafotho ende, nakuba izinto ezinjengomhlambi wezinyoni noma izidalwa ezincane zidinga amanye amalensi.
target: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

source: Izilwane eziningi ezingavamile kunzima ukuzithola, futhi amapaki ngezinye izikhathi anemithetho emayelana nokuthatha izithombe ngenjongo yokuhweba ngazo.
target: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

source: Izilwane zasendle zingaba namahloni noma zibe nolaka. Indawo ingabanda, ishise, noma ibe yimbi ngenye indlela.
target: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

source: Umhlaba unezilimi ezihlukene ezingaphezu kuka-5,000, kuhlanganise nezingaphezu kwamashumi amabili ezinezikhulumi eziyizigidi ezingu-50 noma ngaphezulu.
target: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

source: Kaningi kulula ukuqonda amazwi abhaliwe kunakhulunywayo, futhi. Lokhu kuyiqiniso ngokukhethekile ngamakheli, lawo kaningi okunzima ukuwaphimisela kahle.
target: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

source: Izizwe eziningi eziphelele zisikhuluma kahle isiNgisi, futhi nakwezinye ezengeziwe ungalindela ulwazi olulinganiselwe - ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasha.
target: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

source: Cabanga, uma ungakwazi, umuntu wase-Muncunia, e-Boston, e-Jamaica kanye nowase-Sydney behlezi etafuleni bedla idina esitolo sokudlela sase-Toronto.
target: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

source: Bebezixoxela bebodwa ngezindaba ezivela emadolobheni akubo, baxoxelwa ngolimi lwesigodi sakubo kanye nangendlela yokukhuluma yangakubo.
target: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

source: Ukuthenga ukudla ezitolo ezinkulu ngokuvamile kuyindlela engabizi kunazo zonke yokondleka. Ngaphandle kwamathuba okupheka, ongakukhetha nokho kulinganiselwe ekudleni okulungele udliwa.
target: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

source: Izitolo ezinkulu ngokwandayo zithola ingxenye ehlukahlukene kakhulu yokudla okulungele ukudliwa. Ezinye zinikeza ngisho nangohhavini we-microwave noma enye indlela yokufudumeza ukudla.
target: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

source: Kwamanye amazwe noma izinhlobo zezitolo kunendawo yokudlela eyodwa, ngokuvamile engekho emthethweni enamanani akahle.
target: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

source: Enza futhi uphathe amakhophi epholisi yakho kanye neminingwane yenkampani yakho yomshwalensi.
target: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

source: Badinga ukuveza ikheli le-imeyili lomuntu onikeza ngomshwalense kanye nezinombolo zocingo zakwamanye amazwe zesiluleko/ukunikeza imvume nokufaka izicelo.
target: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

source: Gcina enye ikhophi emthwalweni wakho naku-inthanethi (zithumelele yona ku-imeyili, noma uligcinwe ku-"cloud").
target: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

source: Uma usohambweni uhamba ne-laptop noma uthebhulethi, faka ikhophi yayo kuyo noma kuyidiski (iyatholakala ngisho noma ungenayo i-inthanethi).
target: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

source: Futhi nikeza amakhophi epolisi/isivumelwano kohambisana nabo kanye nezihlobo noma abangane emuva ekhaya abafuna ukusiza.
target: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

source: Izinyamazane ezinkulu zaseMelika (ngezinye izikhathi ezibizwa ngama-elk) azithandi udlame, kodwa zizozivikela lapho zibona ingozi.
target: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

source: Uma abantu bangaboni inyamazane enkulu yaseMelika njengeyingozi, bangasondela kakhulu futhi bazifake engozini.
target: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

source: Phuza iziphuzo ezidakayo ngokulinganisela. Iziphuzo ezidakayo zithinta wonke umuntu ngokuhlukile, futhi ukwazi umkhawulo wakho kubaluleke kakhulu.
target: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

source: Izinto ezithinta impilo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngenxa yokuphuza ngokweqisa zingahlanganisa ukulimala kwesibindi kanye nobumpumputhe nokufa. Ingozi engaba khona iyakhula lapho umuntu ephuza utshwala obungenziwanga ngokomthetho.
target: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

source: Izipiliti ezingekho emthethweni zinezinto ezingacwengekanga ezihlukahlukene ezihlanganisa i-methanol, engabangela ubumpumputhe noma ukufa ngisho noma kuthathwe encane.
target: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

source: Izibuko zamehlo zingabiza kancane kwelinye izwe, ikakhulukazi emazweni aholela imali encane lapho izindleko zokusebenza ziphansi.
target: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

source: Cabangela ukuhlola amehlo ekhaya, ikakhulukazi uma umshwalense ukhokhelela izindleko, kanye noletha amaphepha aloba imithi ukuba agcinwe kwenye indawo.
target: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

source: Amafulemu aseqophelweni eliphezulu wamagama abizayo atholakala kulezi zindawo angaba nezinkinga ezimbili; amanye kungaba omgunyathi, futhi angempela avela kwamanye amazwe angabiza kakhulu kunasekhaya.
target: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

source: Ikhofi lingomunye wemikhiqizo yomhlaba okuhwetshwa ngawo kakhulu, futhi cishe ungathola izinhlobo eziningi endaweni yangakini.
target: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

source: Nokho, ziningi izindlela ezihlukile zokuphuza ikofi emhlabeni jikelele okufanele zizanywe.
target: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

source: I-canyoning (noma: canyoneering) kumayelana nokuya ezansi kwezigodi ezijulile, okungezeka ukuthi zomile noma zigcwele amanzi.
target: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

source: Ukuhamba ezindongeni ezinkulu ezibangelwe umfula kuhlanganisa izici zokubhukuda, ukugibela kanye nokweqa-- kodwa kudinga ukuziqeqesha okuncane kakhulu noma isimo somziba ukuze uqale (uma kuqhathaniswa nokugibela amadwala amakhulu, i-scuba diving noma i-alpine skiing, ngokwesibonelo).
target: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

source: Ukuhamba ezintabeni umsebenzi wangaphandle ohlanganisa ukuhamba ezindaweni ezingokwemvelo, kaningi emizileni yokuhamba.
target: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

source: Ukuhamba emini kuhlanganisa amabanga angaphansi kwemayela kuze kube semabangeni angahlanganiswa ngosuku olulodwa.
target: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

source: Ukuhamba emini emzileni olula kudinga ukuzilungiselela okuncane, futhi noma imuphi umuntu ophile kahle ngokomzimba angakujabulela.
target: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

source: Imindeni enezingane ezincane ingadinga ukulingiselela okwengeziwe, kodwa usuku ngaphandle lungenzeka kalula ngisho nangabantwana abancane kanye nezingane ezingakayi esikoleni.
target: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

source: Emazweni wonke, kunezinhlangano zokuvakasha ezisebenzayo ezicishe zibe ngu-200. Eziningi zazo zizimele.
target: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

source: I-Go Running Tours eyalandela i-Global Running Tours iqondisa izinkampani zezingosi emazwekazini amane.
target: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

source: Nemvelaphi yayo Ohambweni Lokugijima lwase-Barcelona Ukugijima kwase-Barcelona ne-Copenhagen, yajoyinwa ngokushesha uHambo Lokugijima lwase-Prague olunesikhungo e-Prague kanye nezinye.
target: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

source: Kunezinto eziningi okumelwe uzicabangele ngaphambi nalapho uthatha uhambo oluya kwenye indawo.
target: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

source: Uma uthatha uhambo, lindela izinto ukuba zingafani “nasekhaya”. Imikhuba, imithetho, ukudla, ukuminyana kwezimoto, izimiso, ulimi njalonjalo kuzohluka ngandlelathile nalapho uhlala khona.
target: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

source: Lokhu okuthile okumelwe uhlale ukukhumbula, ukugwema ukudumazeka ngisho nokungathandi izindlela zendawo zokwenza izinto.
target: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

source: Izinhlangano zokuhamba bezilokhu zikhona kusukela ngekhulu le-19. Umenzeli wokuhamba ngokuvamile ukhetho oluhle lohambo oludlulela ngaphezu kolwazi lwesihambi lwangaphambili lwendalo, isiko, ulimi noma amazwe aholela imali ephansi.
target: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

source: Nakuba ezinye izinkampani zizimisele ukwenza ukubhukha okuningi okuvamile, izinkampani eziningi zingochwepheshe ohlotshweni oluthize lohambo, ubukhulu bamanani noma izindawo.
target: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

source: Kungaba lula ukusebenzisa ummeli ovame ukubhukha uhambo olufana nolwakho.
target: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

source: Buka ukuthi inkampani ikhangisa ngaluphi uhambo, kungaba kuyiwebhusayithi noma efasiteleni lesitolo.
target: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

source: Uma ufuna ukubona umhlaba ngendlela engabizi, ngoba kunesidingo, indlela yokuphila noma inselele, kunezinye izindlela zokwenza lokho.
target: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

source: Ngokuyisisekelo, baye bawela ezigabeni ezimbili: okungenzeka ukusebenza phakathi nohambo noma ukuzama ukulinganisela izindleko zakho. Lesi sihloko sigxile kulokho okwenzeka ekugcineni.
target: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

source: Kulabo abazimisele ukudela ukunethezeka, isikhathi kanye nokubikezeleka ukunciphisaizindleko baze bacishe bengakhokhi lutho babona izindawo ezikhokhelwa imali encane.
target: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

source: Iseluleko sicabangela ukuthi izihambi azebi, azingeni ezindaweni ngaphandle kwemvume, azihwebi ngokungemthetho, azincengi, noma ziqole abantu ngenye indlela ukuze zizizuzise.
target: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

source: Indawo yokuhlola abavela kwamanye amazwe ngokuvamile iyindawo yokuma yokuqala lapho wehla endizeni, emkhumbini, noma kwenye inqola.
target: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

source: Kwezinye izitimela eziya emazweni angomakhelwane ukuhlolwa kwenziwa esitimeleni esihambayo futhi kumelwe uphathe nomazisi ongokomthetho uma ugibela esinye salezo zitimela.
target: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

source: Kulezi zitimela okulalwa kuzo, iphasiphothi ingathathwa ukhondakta ukwenzela ukuthi ungaphazamiseki uma sewulele.
target: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

source: Ukubhalisa imfuneko eyengeziwe enqubweni ye-visa. Kwamanye amazwe, kumelwe ubhalise ukuba khona kwakho nekheli lalapho uhlala khona neziphathimandla zendawo.
target: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

source: Lokhu kungadinga ukugcwalisa ifomu namaphoyisa endawo noma ukuvakashela ihhovisi labaphuma kwamanye amazwe.
target: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

source: Emazweni amaningi anomthetho onjalo, amahhotela wasendaweni yiwona azobhalisa (qinisekisa ukuthi uyabuza).
target: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

source: Kwezinye izimo, yilabo kuphela abahlala ngaphandle kwezindlu zezivakashi okudingeka ukuthi babhalise. Kodwa-ke, lokhu kwenza umthetho uthi ukuqina, ngakho kubalulekile ukuthi usheshe wazi.
target: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

source: Ezokwakha zigxile ekuklameni nasekwakheni izakhiwo. Ukuklanywa nokwakheka kwendawo ngokuvamile kudonsa izivakashi ngokwakho.
target: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

source: Izakhiwo eziningi zinhle kakhulu ukuzibuka futhi nokubuka indawo usesakhiweni eside noma efasiteleni elibekwe ngobuhlakani kungaba into enhle ukuyibuka.
target: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

source: Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu buhlangana kakhudlwana nezinye izinkundla kuhlanganise nokuhlelwa kwamadolobha, ubunjiniyela bokuklama izakhiwo zomphakathi, ubuciko bokuhlobisa, ukuhlobisa ingaphakathi lezindlu kanye nokuhlobisa amagceke.
target: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

source: Ngendlela imizi yomdabu yaseMelika ikude ngayo, angeke ukwazi ukuthola okwenzekayo ebusuku ngaphandle kokuya e-Albuquerque noma eSanta Fe.
target: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

source: Noma kunjalo, cishe zonke izindawo zokugembula ezibhalwe phezulu zidayisa iziphuzo, kanti eziningana kuzo zihlinzeka ezokuzijabulisa zohlobo oluthile (ngokuvamile ezinkulu kuzo ezakhelene ne-Albuquerque kanye ne-Santa Fe).
target: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

source: Qaphela: izindawo zokuthiba ukoma zedolobha ezincanezalapha azihlali ziyizindawo ezilungele zivakashi ezivela ngaphandle kwesifundazwe ukuthi zingazipholela kuzo.
target: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

source: Esinye isizathu ukuthi, i-New Mexico esenyakatho inezinkinga ezinkulu ngabashayeli abadakiwe, futhi iningi labashayeli abadakiwe litholakala eduze nezinkantini zamadolobhana.
target: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

source: Imifanekiso noma imibhalo engafuneki ibizwa nge-graffiti.
target: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

source: Nakuba kungesona isimangaliso sanamuhla, abantu abaningi cishe bakuhlobanisa nentsha ecekela phansi izakhiwo zomphakathi nezabantu ngopende ofuthwayo.
target: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

source: Nokho, kulezi zinsuku kunezingcweti ze-graffiti ezizimele, izenzakalo ze-graffiti kanye nezindonga "ezingokomthetho". Imidwebo ye-graffiti kulomongo kaningi ifana nomsebenzi wobuciko kunemidwebo engekho emthethweni.
target: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

source: Ukuphonsa i-boomerang ikhono elithandwayo lelo izivakashi eziningi ezifuna ukuba nalo.
target: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

source: Uma ufuna ukufunda ukuphonsa ibhumerangi ebuyela esandleni sakho, qinisekisa ukuthi unebhumerangi efanelekela ukubuya.
target: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

source: Ama-boomerang amaningi atholakala e-Australia empeleni akuwona abuyayo. Kungcono kwabasaqala ukuthi bangazami ukuphonsa emoyeni
target: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

source: ISidlo seHangi siphekelwa emgodini oshisayo.
target: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

source: Umgodi ushiswa ngamatshe ashisayo avela emlilweni, noma kwezinye izindawo ukushisa okuvela ngaphansi komhlaba kwenze izingxenye zenhlabathi zishise ngokwemvelo.
target: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

source: I-hangi kaningi isetshenziselwa ukupheka ukudla kwakusihla okuthosiwe okungokwesiko.
target: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

source: Izindawo ezimbalwa e-Rotorua zinikela ngokudla okuphekwe ngokushisa komhlaba, kanti okunye ukudla okunjalo kuyenziwa e-Christchurch, e-Wellington nakwezinye izindawo.
target: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

source: IMetroRail inezigaba ezimbili zezitimela zabagibeli eKapa kanye nasezindaweni ezizungezile: iMetroPlus (ebuye ibizwe ngokuthi Isigaba Esiphezulu) kanye neMetro (ebizwa ngeSigaba Sesithathu).
target: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

source: IMetroPlus inethezeke kakhudlwana futhi ayigcwali abantu kodwa ibiza kakhudlwana, nakuba ishibhe kunamathikithi esitimela avamile eYurophu.
target: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

source: Zonke izitimela ziba nakho kokubili i-MetroPlus kanye nezinqola ze-Metro; izinqola ze-MetroPlus zihlale njalo zisekugcineni kwesitimela eduze kweDolobha lase-Kappa.
target: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

source: Ukunakekela abanye – Ungalokothi ususe amehlo ezikhwameni zakho, ikakhulukazi lapho weqa imingcwele yamanye amazwe.
target: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

source: Ungazithola usetshenziswa njengomuntu othwala izidakamizwa ngaphandle kolwazi lwakho, okuzokufaka enkingeni enkulu.
target: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

source: Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuma eheleni, njengoba izinja ezithungatha izidakamizwa zingasetshenziswa nganoma isiphi isikhathi ngaphandle kwesaziso.
target: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

source: Amanye amazwe anezindlela zokujezisa ezinonya kakhulu ngisho nakubantu abaqalayo ukuphula umthetho; lezi zingahlanganisa izigwebo zasejele zeminyaka engaphezu kuka-10 noma ukufa.
target: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

source: Izikhwama ezinganakwanga zitshontshwa kalula futhi zingadonsa ukunaka kweziphathimandla eziqaphele ukusongelwa ngamabhomu.
target: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

source: Ekhaya, ngenxa yalokhu kuvezwa njalo kwamagciwane endawo, amathuba asephezulu kakhulu okuthi kungenzeka nawe usugomekile kuwo.
target: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

source: Kodwa kwezinye izingxenye zomhlaba, lapho amagciwane e-fauna emasha kuwe, maningi amathuba okuthi ube nenkinga.
target: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

source: Futhi, ezindaweni ezifudumele amabhakithiliya kokubili akhula ngokushesha kakhudwlana futhi aphila isikhathi eside kakhudlwana ngaphandle komzimba.
target: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

source: Ngakho izishayo zaseDelhi Belly, i-Pharaoh's Curse, iMontezuma's Revenge, kanye nabangane babo abaningi.
target: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

source: Njengezinkinga zokuphefumula ezindaweni ezinesimo sezulu ezibandayo, izinkinga zesisu ezindaweni ezinesimo sezulu esishisayo zivamile futhi ezimweni eziningi ziyacika ngokukhethekile kodwa aziyona ingozi empeleni.
target: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

source: Uma uthatha uhambo oluya ezweni elisathuthuka okokuqala – noma engxenyeni entsha yomhlaba – ungadeleli ukushaqeka ngenxa yesiko okungaba khona.
target: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

source: Izihambi eziningi ezizinzile, ezinamandla zikhungathekiswe ubusha bohambo lomhlabo oluthuthukayo, lapho ukushintsha okuncane okuningi kwesiko kungahlangana ngokushesha.
target: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

source: Ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini zakho zokuqala, cabangela ikuchitha imali eningi ezindleleni zaseNtshonalanga zokwenza izinto kanye namahhotela ezinga eliphezulu, ukudla, kanye nezinkonzo ukukusiza ujwayele.
target: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

source: Ungalali kumatilasi noma endwangwini entofontofo phansi ezindaweni ongazi kuzo izilwane zendawo.
target: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

source: Uma uzoya ukuyokhempa ngaphandle, woza ne-camp cot noma ne-hammock ukuze uzivikele ezinyokeni, ofezela nokunye okucishe kufane.
target: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

source: Gcwalisa ikhaya lakho ngekhofi elinothile ekuseni kanye netiye le-chamomile elenza uphumule ebusuku.
target: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

source: Uma uthatha iholide usekhaya lakho, unesikhathi sokuzijabulisa nesokuthatha imizuzu embalwa yokwenza okuthile okubalulekile.
target: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

source: Uma uzizwa ufisa ukwenza izigigaba, thatha ithuba lokwenza ijusi noma uhlanganise izithelo ezihlukahlukene ukuze kube yisiphuzo:
target: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

source: mhlawumbe uzothola isiphuzo esilula ongasenza sokudla kwasekuseni uma ubuyela esimisweni sakho sansuku zonke.
target: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

source: Uma uhlala edolobheni elinesiko lokuphuza elihlukile, yana ezinkantinini noma izindlini zokuphuzela emiphakathini ongavamisanga ukuya kuyo.
target: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

source: Kulabo abangajwayele amagama asetshenziswa kwezokwelapha, amagama athi ukuthelelana kanye nokuthathelana anezinzazelo ezikhukile.
target: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

source: Isifo esithelelanayo sibangelwa amabhakithiliya adala izifo, njengegciwane, ibhakithiliya, isikhunta noma ezinye izilwane eziphila ngezinye.
target: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

source: Isifo esithathelanwayo isifo esidluliseka kalula ngokuba seduze nomuntu onalesosifo.
target: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

source: Ohulumeni abaningi bafuna izivakashi ezingenayo, noma abahlali abahambayo, emazweni abo ukuba bagonyelwe izinhlobonhlobo zezifo.
target: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

source: Lezimfuneko kaningi zingaxhomeka emazweni isihambi esiwavakashele noma esihlele ukuwavakashela.
target: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

source: Enye yezindawo ezinamandla zeCharlotte, eNyakatho Carolina, ukuthi inezinto eziningi ezisezingeni eliphezulu imindeni engakhetha kuzo.
target: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

source: Abahlali abavela kwezinye izindawo bavame ukukhuluma ngezinto ezifanele umndeni njengesizathu esiyinhloko sokuthuthela lapho, futhi izivakashi kaningi zithola kulula ukujabulela idolobha nezingane.
target: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

source: Eminyakeni engu-20 edlule, inani lezinto eziphephile ezinganeni Phakathi Edolobheni lase-Charlotte lande kakhulu.
target: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

source: Amatekisi awavamisanga ukusetshenziswa imindeni eCharlotte, ngisho noma engaba usizo kwezinye izimo.
target: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

source: Kunenhlawuliso engaphezulu yokuba nabagibeli abangaphezu kuka-2, ngakho lokhu ongakukhetha kungaba okubiza kakhulu kunalokho okudingekayo.
target: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

source: I-Antarctica indawo ebanda kunazo zonke eMhlabeni, futhi izungeze iSouth Pole.
target: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

source: Ukuvakasha kwezivakashi kuyabiza, kudinga ukuphila kahle ngokomzimba, kungenzeka kuphela ngehlobo ngoNovemba kuya kuFebhruwari, futhi kulinganiselwe kakhulu ngokomthetho eNhlonhlweni, Eziqhingini kanye nasoLwandle iRoss.
target: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

source: Izinkulungwane ezimbalwa zezisebenzi zihlala lapha ehlobo ezikhungweni ezingaba amadazini amane kaningi kulezo zindawo; inani elincane lihlala ebusika.
target: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

source: Phakathi nezwe le-Antarctica inkangala engahlali muntu embozwe u-2-3 km weqhwa.
target: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

source: Kwezinye izikhathi ukuvakasha kwasemoyeni kochwephesha kuya phakathi nezwe, ukugibela izintaba noma ukufinyelela kuyiPole, enesiqu esikhulu.
target: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

source: ISouth Pole Traverse (noma iHighway) umzila ongama-1600 kma kusuka eMcMurdo Station oLwandle lweRosa kuyiPole.
target: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

source: Kuyiqhwa elihlangene eligcwele imisele ebekiswe ngamafulegi. Ungahamba kulo kuphela ngogandaganda abakhandelwe lokho, izinqola zokuhamba eqhweni ezinamafutha kanye nezinye izinto ezisetshenziswayo.
target: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

source: Lezi azilula kakhulu ngakho umzila kumelwe uphambukele kude uzungeze iziNtaba zeTransantarctic ukungena enkangaleni.
target: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

source: Into eyimbangela evamile yezingozi ebusika imigwaqo eshelelayo, imigwaqo egandayiwe (izindawo zokuhamba) futhi ikakhulukazi izitebhisi.
target: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

source: Ngokwesilinganiso, udinga izicathulo ezinesithende ezifanelekile. Izicathulo zasehlobo ngokuvamile ziyashelela eqhweni kanye nasesithwathweni, ngisho nezinye izicathulo zasebusika azifaneleki.
target: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

source: Isifanekiso kumelwe sijule ngokwanele, u-5 mm (1/5 yintshi) noma ngaphezulu, futhi indwangu kumelwe ithambe ngokwanele emazingeni okushisa abandayo.
target: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

source: Amanye amabhuzu anezinto ezicijile futhi kezinto ezicijile ezifakwayo zezimo ezishelelayo, ezifaneleke izicathulo namabhuzu, ezezithende noma izithende namasoli.
target: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

source: Izithende kumelwe zibe ezansi futhi zibe banzi. Isihlabathi, inhlabathi enamatshana noma usawoti (i-calcium chloride) kuvame ukusakazeka ezindleleni noma emizileni ukuthuthukisa amandla okubamba.
target: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

source: Izikhukhula zeqhwa aziyona into engavamile; izindawo ezehlelayo zingabamba iqhwa elanele nje, futhi elengeziwe lizokwehla njengesikhukhula seqhwa.
target: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

source: Inkinga ukuthi iqhwa liyanamathela, ngakho-ke lidinga ukuthi ukuthintithwa ukuze lehle, kanti neqhwa elithile elehlayo lingabangela ukuthi lonke elinye lehle.
target: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

source: Kwezinye izikhathi isenzakalo sangempela esishukumisayo ilanga elifudumeza iqhwa, kwesinye isikhathi ukuwa kweqhwa elengeziwe, kwesinye isikhathi ezinye izenzakalo ezingokwemvelo, kaningi umuntu.
target: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

source: Isivunguvungu insika yokucindezela komoya okungenamandla, emunyela umoya oseduze phakathi kanye naphezulu.
target: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

source: Zingenza imimoya ephakeme (ngokuvamile amamayeli angu-100-200/ihora) futhi zingaphakamisa izinto ezisindayo emoyeni, zizithwale njengoba isivunguvungu sihamba.
target: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

source: Ziqala njengamafanela ayehlayo emafwini wesiphepho, bese ziba “izivunguvungu” lapho zifika phansi.
target: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

source: Izinkampani ze-VPN Yomuntu Siqu (inethiweki yomuntu siqu ebonakala ingokoqobo) ziyindlela ekahle kakhulu yokugwema ukuhlola okungokwepolotiki kanye zihlungi zendawo ze-IP.
target: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

source: Baphambili kuma proxies eweb ngenxa yezizathu eziningana: Benza umzila wonke wokuthengisa i-Inthanethi, hhayi i-http kuphela.
target: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

source: Bajwayele ukunikeza izinga eliphezulu bobungakho bokudlulisa futhi nezinga eliphezulu losizo. Bafihle ukwaziswa ngakho kunzima ukwazi ukuthi baphezu kwani.
target: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

source: Izinkampani zezezindaba kaningi ziqamba amanga ngenjongo yalokhu, zithi kungenxa "yokuvimbela ukuba imfihlo".
target: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

source: Empeleni, amakhodi wendawo awasebenzi nakancane ekukopeni okungekho emthethweni; ukukopa kwe-bit nge-bit kwediski kuzoyenza idlale kahle kunoma iyiphi idivayisi lapho idiski yangempela ingadlala khona.
target: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

source: Injongo yangempela ukwenza lezo zinkampani zilawule kakhudlwana izimakethe zazo; konke kumayelana nokwenza inzuzo.
