target: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

source: Ngenxa yokuthi izingcingo zixhunywa nge-Inthanethi, akumelwe usebenzise ifoni yenkampani esendaweni ohlala kuyo noma oyivakashele.
target: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

source: Futhi azikho izimfuneko ozitholayo ngenani emphakathini ohlala kuwo; ungathola ukuxhuma ngesethelithi ku-inthanethi eziNkukhwini zasendle, e-Alska bese ukhetha inani elibonisa ukuthi usekushiseni e-Arizona.
target: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

source: Kaningi, kufanele uthenge inombolo esebenza emhlabeni jikelele ngokuhlukile evumela amafoni we-PSTN ukuba akushayele. Lapho inombolo isuka khona kwenza umehluko kubantu abakushayelayo.
target: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

source: Ama-app wokuhumusha we-Real-time – izinhlelo ezikwazi ukuhumusha ngokuzenzakalelayo zonke izingxenye zombhalo kusuka olimini olulodwa kuya kolunye.
target: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

source: Ezinye izinhlelo kulengxenye zingaphinde zihumushe imibhalo ezilimini ezihlukahlukene kanye nakolwezandla noma ezinye izinto emhlabeni wangempela lapho oyisebenzisayo ekhomba umakhalekhukhwini wesimanje kulezo zinto.
target: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

source: Izinhlelo zekhompyutha zokuhumusha zithuthuke kakhulu, futhi manje zinikeza ukuhumusha okucishe kunembe (futhi okungavamisile ukuba ubhedo ongachazeki), kodwa kudingeka ukunaka okuthile, njengoba zingenza okunganembile ngokuphelele.
target: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

source: Olunye lwezinhlelo zokusebenza ezihamba phambili kulesi sigaba yi-Guguli Humusha, evumela ukuhumusha ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi ngemva kokudawuniloda idatha yolimi olufunwayo.
target: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

source: Ukusebenzisa ama-app wokuqondisa we-GPS kuyi-smartphone sakho kungaba yindlela elula kakhulu newusizo kakhulu yokuthungatha indlela lapho ungekho ezweni lakini.
target: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

source: Ingonga imali kunokuthenga amabalazwe we-GPS amasha, noma i-GPS ezimele noma ukuqasha enye enkampanini yokuqashisa izimoto.
target: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

source: Uma ungenalo uxhumano lwedatha kuyifoni yakho, noma uma ingasebenzi endaweni okuyo, ukusebenza kwazo kungalinganiselwa noma kungabi khona.
target: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

source: Noma iziphi izitolo ezincane zigcwele ngezinhlobonhlobo ezididayo zamakhadi wefoni akhokhelwa kusengaphambili lawo angasetshenziswa ezingcingweni zomphakathi noma ocingweni oluvamile.
target: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

source: Yize amanye amakhadi ekulungele ukufonela noma ikuphi, kodwa amanye enzelwe ukunikeza amanani aphansi wokufona emaqenjini athile wamazwe.
target: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

source: Ukufinyelela kulamasevisikuvame ukutholakala ezinombolweni zocingo zamahhalaezingafonelwa ezingcingweni eziningi ngaphandle koku khokhela.
target: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

source: Imithetho esebenza ekuthwebuleni isithombe esivamile iyasebenza nesekuqopheni ividiyo, cishe nangokwengeziwe.
target: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

source: Uma ukuthatha ifotho yokuthile nje kungavunyelwe, akufanele ucabange ngisho nangokurekhoda ividiyo yakho.
target: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

source: Uma wenza umsindo obeleselayo, hlola kusengaphambili ukuthi ikuphi ovunyelwe ukukuthwebula nokuthi yiziphi izimvume noma amalayisensi engeziwe edingekayo.
target: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

source: Ukundizisa izindiza eziqondiswa nge-remote eduze kwesikhumulo sezindiza noma phakathi kwabantu abaningi akuwona umqondo omuhle, ngisho noma kungekho emthwethweni lokho endaweni yangakini.
target: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

source: Esikhathini samanje ukuhamba ngendiza akuvile ukubhukhiwa ngokuqondile nenkampani yezindiza ngaphandle kokusesha nokuqhathanisa amanani.
target: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

source: Kwesinye isikhathi indiza efanayo ingaba namanani ahluke kakhulu ezintweni ezihlukile ezihlanganisayo futhi kuyazuzisa ukuqhathanisa imiphumela yokusesha kanye nokubuka iwebhusayithi yenkampani yezindiza ngokwayo ngaphambi kokubhukha.
target: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

source: Nakuba ungena kudinga i-visa ukuthatha uhambo olufishane lokuya emazweni athile njengesivakashi noma ngenxa yebhizinisi, ukuya lapho njengomfundi wakwelinye izwekudingeka uhlale isikhathi eside kunomuntu nje ovakashe isikhashana.
target: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

source: Ngokuvamile, ukuhlala kwelinye izwe isikhathi eside kuzodinga ukuthi uthole ivisa kusengaphambili.
target: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

source: Amavisa wabafundi afuna izinto ezihlukahlukene nezindlela zokufaka isicelo ezivakashini ezivamile noma amavisa webhizinisi.
target: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

source: Emazweni amaningi, uzodinga incwadi yalokho enivumelene ngakho engxoxweni yenu nesikhungweni ofisa ukufunda kuso, kanye nobufakazi bemali yokuziphilisa okungenani unyaka wokuqala wesifundo sakho.
target: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

source: Hlola nesikhungo, kanye nomnyango wabafuduki wezwe ongathanda ukufundela kulo ukuze uthole imininingwane eminingi.
target: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

source: Ngaphandle kokuba ungusomaqhinga wezindaba zamazwe, ukusebenza phesheya ngokuvamile kusho ukuthi kuzodingeka ukhokhe intela ezweni okulona.
target: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

source: Intela yomholo ihlelwe ngendlela ehlukile emazweni ahlukene, futhi namanani nezingxenye ezehlukile zentelaziyehlukahlukakusuka kwelinye izwe kuya kwelinye.
target: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

source: Kwamanye amazwe kahulumeni, afana neMelika ne-Canada, kuqoqwa intela kokubili ezingeni likahulumeni nasezingeni lendawo, ngakho amanani namabhulekethi kungahluka endaweni ngendawo.
target: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

source: Nakuba ukuhlolwa kwabantu abathuthela kwelinye izwe kungenziwa uma ufika ezweni lakho, ukudlula lapho kuhlolwa khona izincwadi kusenzima.
target: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

source: Qinisekisa ukuthi uyazi ukuthi yini ongeza nayo nongenakuza nayo futhi ubike noma yini kwabomthetho.
target: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

source: Indlela elula kakhulu yokuqalisa ebhizinisini lokubhala ngohambo ukuthuthukisa amakhono wakho kuyibhulogi yewebhusayithi yokuhamba emisiwe.
target: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

source: Uma ukhululeka ngokususa nokwenezela izinto kuyiwebhu, kamuva, ungenza eyakho iwebhusayithi.
target: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

source: Ukuvolontiya njengoba uthatha uhambo indlela ekahle yokwenza umehluko kodwa akuphathelananga nokunikela nje.
target: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

source: Ukuhlala nokuvolontiya kwelinye izwe indlela ekahle yokwazi isiko elihlukile, ukuhlangana nabantu abasha, ukufunda ngawe, ukuthola eminye imibono ngisho nokuthola amakhono amasha.
target: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

source: Kungabuye kube indlela ekahle yokusebenzisa kahle imali ukukuvumela ukuba uhlale isikhathi eside kakhudlwana kwenye indawo njengoba imisebenzi eminingi yokuvolontiya ihlinzeka indawo yokuhlala nokudla futhi embalwa iholela iholo.
target: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

source: Ama-viking asebenzisa imisele yaseRashiya ukuya oLwandle Olumnyama noLwandle i-Caspian. Ezinye zalezi zindlela zisengasetshenziswa. Hlola uma kudingeka izimvume ezikhethekile, okungaba nzima ukuzithola.
target: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

source: Ulwandle oluMhlophe–Umsele i-Baltic luhlanganisa uLwandlekazi i-Arctic noLwandle i-Baltic, ngendlela yeChibi i-Onega, iChibi i-Ladoga kanye ne-Saint Petersburg, kakhulu ngemifula namachibi.
target: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

source: IChibi i-Onega libuye laxhumana ne-Volga, ngakho ukuza usuka oLwandle lwase-Caspian udlula eRashiya kusenzeka.
target: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

source: Qiniseka ukuthi lapho nje ufika ezikhumulweni zemikhumbi yonke into izoba sobala kakhulu. Uzohlangana nabanye abacela ukugitsheliswa emikhumbini futhi bazokwabelana nawe ngolwazi lwabo.
target: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

source: Ngokuyisisekelo uzobe ufaka izaziso zosizo olunikezayo, wehla wenyuka ezikhumulweni zemikhumbi, ulanda bantu abahlanza izikebhe zawoseyili, uzama ukuxhumana namatilosi ezinkantini, njalo njalo.
target: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

source: Zama ukukhuluma nabantu abaningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Ngemva kwesikhashana wonke umuntu uzokwazi futhi uzokunika amacebiso okuthi isiphi isikebhe esifuna umuntu.
target: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

source: Kufanele ukhethe inkampani yakho yezindiza ye-Fuest Flyer kumfelandawonye ngokucophelela.
target: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

source: Noma ungahle ucabange ukuthi ungazikhethela ukujoyina umzila wezindiza owusebenzisa kakhulu, kumelwe uqaphele ukuthi amalungelo anikezwayo ayashintshashintsha kanti namaphuzu angase abonelele kwezinye izindlela zokundiza ngemali efanayo.
target: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

source: Izinkampani zezindiza ezifana ne-Emirates, i-Etihad Airways, i-Qatar Airways kanye ne-Turkish Airlines zandise izinkonzo zazo kakhulu e-Afrika, futhi zixhumanisa namanye amadolobha amakhulu wase-Afrika ngamanani aphansi kunezinye izinkampani zezindiza zaseYurophu.
target: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

source: Inkampani Yezindiza yaseTheki inezindiza eziya ezindaweni ezingu-39 emazweni angu-30 wase-Afrika kusukela ngo-2014.
target: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

source: Uma unesikhathi esengeziwe sohambo, hlola ukuthi lithini inani lokuya e-Afrika uma liqhathaniswa nelokuzungeza umhlaba.
target: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

source: Ungakhohlwa ukufaka izindleko ezengeziwe zamanye ama-visa, izintela zokuhamba, izinto zokuthutha, njll. kuzo zonke lezo zindawo ngaphandle kwase-Afrika.
target: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

source: Uma ufuna ukundiza emhlabeni wonke ngokuphelele eNyakatho Nenkabazwe, ungakhetha izindiza nendawo ofuna ukuya kuyo kuye ngokulinganiselwa kokuntuleka kwemizila yasolwandle.
target: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

source: Ayikho inhlangano yezindiza ehlanganisa zonke izindlela ezintathu zokuya ngaphesheya kwezilwandle ezinkulu eNingizimu neNkabazwe (futhi IqembuIsibhakabhaka alihlanganisi lezi zindlela).
target: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

source: Nokho, Inhlangano yeNkanyezi ihlanganisa yonke into ngaphandle kweNingizimu Phasifiki esempumalanga kusuka eSantiago de Chile kuya eTahiti, okuyindawo yokubalekela Yezwe elilodwa leLATAM.
target: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

source: Indiza ayikhona nje ukuphela kwento ongayikhetha uma ufuna ukudabula izilwandle zaseNingizimu Pacific kanye nogu olusentshonalanga yeNingizimu Melika. (bheka ngezansi)
target: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

source: Ngo-1994, uhlanga lwama-Amernian Nagorno-Karabakh esifundeni sase-Azerbaijan yahloma impi ngokumelene no-Azeris.
target: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

source: Isekelwa i-Armenia, iriphabhuliki entsha yenziwa. Nokho, alikho izwe elizimele - hhayi ngisho ne-Armenia - eliyiqaphele ngokomthetho.
target: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

source: Izimpikiswano zezifundiswa phakathi kwesifunda ziyaqhubeka zilimaza ubudlelwane phakathi kwe-Armenia kanye ne-Azerbaijan.
target: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

source: ICanal District (ngesiDashi: Grachtengordel) isigodi esidumile sangekhulu lama-17 leminyaka esizungeze iBinnestad yase-Amsterdam.
target: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

source: Indawo yonke imiswe njengeNdawo Yefa Lomhlaba ye-UNESCO ngenxa yesiko layo elihlukile negugu elingokomlando, futhi amanani wezindlu aphakathi kwamanye aphezulu ezweni.
target: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

source: ICinque Terre, okusho ukuthi Amazwe Amahlanu, ihlanganisa imizi emincane emihlanu engasogwini yeRiomaggiore, iManarola, iCorniglia, iVernazza kanye neMoterosso esendaweni yaseNtaliyane yaseLiguria.
target: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

source: Bafakiwe Ohlwini lwe-UNESCO Lefa Lomhlaba.
target: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

source: Ngemva kwamakhulu eminyaka, abantu bebakha ngokucophelela izindawo zokuphola ezindaweni ezingaqondile, izindaweni ezehlelayo emaweni abheke olwandle.
target: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

source: Ingxenye yobuhle bayo ukungabonakali kwezakhiwo ezakhiwayo. Izindlela, izitimela kanye nezikebhe kuxhumanisa amadolobhana, futhi izimoto azikwazi ukuwafinyelela kusuka ngaphandle.
target: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

source: Ukuhluka kwesiFulentshi esikhulunywa eBheljiyamu nase-Switzerland kuhluka kancane nesiFulentshi esikhulunywa eFulansi, nakuba sifana ngokwanele ukuthi singazwisiseka kokubili.
target: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

source: Ikakhulukazi, uhlelo lokubala e-Belgium kanye nase-Switzerland ekhuluma isiFulentshi nokuhluka okuncane esiFulentshini esikhulunywa eFulansi, futhi ukuphinyiselwa kwamagama athile kuhlukile kancane.
target: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

source: Nakuba kunjalo, bonke abantu base-Belgium nase-Switzerland abakhuluma isiFulentshi bayobe befunde isiFulentshi esivamile esikoleni, ngakho bangaqonda okushoyo ngisho noma usebenzise indlela yokubala evamile yesiFulentshi.
target: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

source: Ezingxenyeni eziningi zomhlaba, ukuvayela ngesandla isenzo sobungane, esibonisa ukuthi "sawubona."
target: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

source: Nokho, eMalaysia, okungenani phakathi kwezindawo zasemaphandleni zaseMalay, kusho ukuthi "woza," ngokufanayo nonkomba ogotshelwe ngasemzimbeni, isenzo esisetshenziswa kwamanye amazwe aseNtshonalanga, futhi kumelwe sisetshenziselwe leyo njongo kuphela.
target: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

source: Ngokufanayo, isihambi saseBrithani eSpeyini singenza iphutha lokucabanga ukuthi ukuvayela okuhlanganisa intende yesandla ebheke umvayeli (kunomuntu ovayelwayo) isho ukuthi buya.
target: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

source: Izilimi zesikhashana izilimi ekungezona ezangempela noma ezakhiwe ngenhloso yokulungiselela ukukhulumisana phakathi kwabantu ababezoba nenkinga yokukhulumisana uma kwakungenjalo.
target: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

source: Zihlukile ezilimini eziyinhloko, okuyizilimi ezingokwemvelo noma eziphilayo ezaba eziyinhloko ngenxa yezizathu ezithile njengendlela yokukhulumisana phakathi kwezikhulumi zezinye izilimi.
target: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

source: Uma kuwusuku olushisayo, izihambi zingabona utalagu olubukeka njengamanzi (noma ezinye izinto).
target: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

source: Lezi zingaba ingozi uma isihambi silandela utalagu, simosha amandla ayigugu kanye namanzi asele.
target: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

source: Ngisho nezingwadule ezishisa kakhulu zibanda ngokwedlulele ebusuku.Ukwehla kwezinga lokushisa komzimba ingozi yangempela ngaphandle kwezimpahla ezifudumele.
target: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

source: Ehlobo, ikakhulukazi, kuzomelwe uqaphele omiyane uma unquma ukuhamba ehlathini lemvula.
target: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

source: Ngishoushayela ehlathini lemvula elinezihlahla ezinde, imizuzwana embalwa ngenkathi uvule izicabha zemoto ukuze ungene kuyona iyisikhathi esanele ukuthi omiyane bangene emotweni Kanye nawe.
target: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

source: Umkhuhlane wezinyoni, noma owaziwa ngokusemthethweni njengomkhuhlane we-Avian, ungatheleleka kokubili izinyoni nezilwane ezincelisayo.
target: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

source: Ukugula okungaphansi kwenkulungwane kubikiwe ebantwini, kodwa okunye kwakho bekubulala.
target: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

source: Abaningi bahlanganisa abantu abasebenza ngezinkukhu, kodwa zikhona nezingozi kubabheki bezinyoni.
target: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

source: Ngokujwayelekile eNorway ukungenela kolwandle okuphahlwe amawa kanye nezigodi ezivulela ithafa eliphakeme, cishe elilingene.
target: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

source: Lezi zinkangala zivamise ukubhekiselwa ngokuthi "vidde" okusho indawo ebanzi, evulekile engenamithi, indawo engenamikhawulo.
target: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

source: ERogaland nase-Agder zivame ukubizwa ngokuthi "hei" okusho inkangala engenamithi kaningi embozwe i-heather.
target: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

source: Amagilesiya awasimamanga, kodwa ehlela phansi kwentaba. Lokhu kuzobangela ukuqhekeka, imifantu, engafihlwa amabhuloho eqhwa.
target: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

source: Izindonga kanye nophahla lwemihume yeqhwa lungawa futhi imiklayeko ingavaleka.
target: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

source: Onqenqemeni lwamagilasiya izinguzungu ezinkulu ziyahlephuka, ziwele phansi noma mhlawumbe zigxume noma zigingqikele kude nongqengqema.
target: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

source: Inkathi yezivakashi ezindaweni zamagquma iyenyuka phakathi nehlobo laseNdiya.
target: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

source: Nokho, zinenhlobo ehlukile yobuhle nokukhanga phakathi nobusika, ngamagquma amanithi athola iqhwa elanele nanikeza okokuzijabulisa okunjengokushushuluza eqhweni noma ukuntweza ngoqembe eqhweni.
target: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

source: Izinkampani zezindiza ezimbalwa kuphela ezinika isaphulelo sabaya emngwabeni, esinciphisa kancane inani lohambo olungenxa yomngcwabo lomzuzu wokugcina.
target: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

source: Izinkampani zezindiza ezinikeza lokhu zihlanganisa i-Air Canada, i-Delta Air lines, neLufthansa yezindiza ezinze eMelika noma e-Canada, kanye ne-WestJet.
target: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

source: Kuzo zonke izimo, kumelwe ubhukhe ngefoni ngokuqondile nenkampani yezindiza.
target: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
